title.raw: 卷103 志七十八 舆服二

sentences.zh: 志七十八

translations.literal: Treatise 78
translations.idiomatic: Treatise Seventy-Eight

sentences.zh: 輿服二

translations.literal: Carriages and Dress, Part Two
translations.idiomatic: Carriages and Dress, Part Two

sentences.zh: 皇帝冠服皇后冠服太皇太后皇太后附皇貴妃以下冠服

translations.literal: Imperial crown and dress; empress crown and dress; grand empress dowager and empress dowager (with appended: imperial noble consort and below, crown and dress)
translations.idiomatic: Imperial crown and dress; empress crown and dress; grand empress dowager and empress dowager—with imperial noble consort and below appended

sentences.zh: 皇子親王以下冠服皇子親王福晉以下冠服

translations.literal: Imperial sons and princes, princes and below, crown and dress; imperial sons, princes, and princess consorts, consorts and below, crown and dress
translations.idiomatic: Crown and dress for imperial sons and princes down the ranks; crown and dress for princess consorts and consorts of princes and below

sentences.zh: 文武官冠服命婦冠服士庶冠服

translations.literal: Civil and military officials' crown and dress; titled ladies' crown and dress; scholars and commoners' crown and dress
translations.idiomatic: Crown and dress for civil and military officials, titled ladies, and scholars and commoners

sentences.zh: 崇德二年，諭諸王、貝勒曰：「昔金熙宗及金主亮廢其祖宗時冠服，改服漢人衣冠。

translations.literal: In the second year of Chongde, an edict was issued to the princes and beile, saying: "Formerly Emperor Xizong of Jin and Emperor Hailing abolished the caps and robes of their ancestors' era and changed to Han Chinese caps and robes.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Chongde, the throne instructed the princes and beile: "In former times Emperor Xizong of Jin and Emperor Hailing cast aside the caps and robes of their forefathers' day and adopted Han Chinese dress.

sentences.zh: 迨至世宗，始復舊制。

translations.literal: When it came to Emperor Shizong, the old system was then restored.
translations.idiomatic: Only under Emperor Shizong was the former system restored.

sentences.zh: 我國家以騎射為業，今若輕循漢人之俗，不親弓矢，則武備何由而習乎？

translations.literal: Our state takes mounted archery as its foundation; if we now lightly follow Han custom and do not handle bow and arrow, how shall martial readiness be practiced?
translations.idiomatic: Our dynasty was founded on horsemanship and archery; if we lightly adopt Han ways and no longer handle bow and arrow, how will martial skill be maintained?

sentences.zh: 射獵者，演武之法；

translations.literal: Hunting with bow is a method for drilling the military;
translations.idiomatic: Hunting with bow and arrow is the way to train for war;

sentences.zh: 服制者，立國之經。

translations.literal: dress regulations are the constant principles of founding a state.
translations.idiomatic: dress regulations are the enduring charter of a nation.

sentences.zh: 嗣後凡出師、田獵，許服便服，其餘悉令遵照國初定制，仍服朝衣。

translations.literal: Hereafter, whenever going on campaign or hunting in the fields, wearing informal dress is permitted; for all other occasions everyone is ordered to follow the founding regulations and still wear court robes.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth, on campaign or in the hunt informal dress may be worn; on all other occasions everyone must follow the regulations established at the founding and wear court robes.

sentences.zh: 並欲使後世子孫勿輕變棄祖制。

translations.literal: This is also intended so that later generations' descendants shall not lightly alter and abandon ancestral regulations.
translations.idiomatic: This is also so that posterity may not lightly alter and cast aside the institutions of our ancestors.

sentences.zh: 」乾隆三十七年，三通館進呈所纂嘉禮考，於遼、金、元各代冠服之制，敘載未能明晰。

translations.literal: " In the thirty-seventh year of Qianlong, the Santong Guan submitted the Jiali kao they had compiled; in narrating the cap and robe systems of the Liao, Jin, and Yuan, the account was not sufficiently clear.
translations.idiomatic: " In the thirty-seventh year of Qianlong, the Santong Guan presented its compiled Examination of Auspicious Rites; its treatment of Liao, Jin, and Yuan cap-and-robe regulations lacked clarity.

sentences.zh: 奉諭：「遼、金、元衣冠，初未嘗不循其國俗，後乃改用漢、唐儀式。

translations.literal: An imperial edict was received: "The caps and robes of Liao, Jin, and Yuan at first did not fail to follow their national customs, but later they changed to use Han and Tang forms.
translations.idiomatic: An edict followed: "The dress of Liao, Jin, and Yuan at first followed their own national customs; only later did they adopt Han and Tang ceremonial forms.

sentences.zh: 其因革次第，原非出於一時。

translations.literal: The order of their reforms was originally not accomplished at a single time.
translations.idiomatic: The sequence of their reforms did not unfold all at once.

sentences.zh: 即如金代朝祭之服，其先雖加文飾，未至盡棄其舊。

translations.literal: For example, the court and sacrifice robes of the Jin: at first although ornament was added, the old style was not yet wholly abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: Take the Jin court and sacrificial robes: at first ornament was added, but the old style was not yet wholly cast aside.

sentences.zh: 至章宗乃概為更制。

translations.literal: Only under Emperor Zhangzong was everything comprehensively redesigned.
translations.idiomatic: Only under Emperor Zhangzong was the entire system redesigned.

sentences.zh: 是應詳考，以徵蔑棄舊典之由。

translations.literal: This should be investigated in detail to show the reasons for despising and abandoning the old canon.
translations.idiomatic: This should be examined in detail to show why the old canon was despised and abandoned.

sentences.zh: 衣冠為一代昭度，夏收殷冔，不相沿襲。

translations.literal: Caps and robes are the shining standards of a dynasty; the Xia used summer garments, the Yin used headdresses—not inherited in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Caps and robes embody a dynasty's visible standard; the Xia wore summer dress and the Yin wore ceremonial caps—each did not simply inherit the last.

sentences.zh: 凡一朝所用，原各自有法程，所謂禮不忘其本也。

translations.literal: Whatever one dynasty used each originally had its own regulations—what is called ritual not forgetting its root.
translations.idiomatic: Whatever a dynasty adopted had its own proper regulations—this is what is meant by ritual never forgetting its root.

sentences.zh: 自北魏始有易服之說，至遼、金、元諸君浮慕好名，一再世輒改衣冠，盡去其純樸素風。

translations.literal: From the Northern Wei there began talk of changing dress; the rulers of Liao, Jin, and Yuan, floating in admiration and fond of fame, changed caps and robes every generation or two, wholly losing their pure rustic character.
translations.idiomatic: From the Northern Wei onward came proposals to change dress; the rulers of Liao, Jin, and Yuan, vain and fond of display, altered caps and robes every generation or two until their plain native style was wholly lost.

sentences.zh: 傳之未久，國勢浸弱。

translations.literal: Transmitted not long, national strength gradually weakened.
translations.idiomatic: Before long their states grew steadily weaker.

sentences.zh: 況揆其議改者，不過雲袞冕備章，文物足觀耳。

translations.literal: Moreover, weighing those who proposed change, it was only that the dragon robe and cap were fully ornamented and the cultural display was sufficient to view.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, those who urged change cared only that the dragon robe and ceremonial cap be fully ornamented and the regalia splendid to behold.

sentences.zh: 殊不知潤色章身，即取其文，亦何必僅沿其式？

translations.literal: They did not realize that adorning the body with pattern—taking its ornament—why must one only follow its form?
translations.idiomatic: They failed to see that to adorn the body with pattern is to take its meaning—why must one copy its form alone?

sentences.zh: 如本朝所定朝祀之服，山龍藻火，粲然具列，皆義本禮經，而又何通天絳紗之足雲耶？

translations.literal: As the court and sacrifice robes fixed by this dynasty display mountains, dragons, flame, and algae in bright array, all meaning derived from the ritual classics—what need is there to speak of Tongtian purple gauze?
translations.idiomatic: The court and sacrificial robes ordained by this dynasty display mountains, dragons, flame, and algae in full splendor, all grounded in the ritual classics—what need is there for the Tongtian purple gauze of antiquity?

sentences.zh: 」蓋清自崇德初元，已釐定上下冠服諸制。

translations.literal: " Thus from the beginning of Chongde the Qing had already settled regulations for caps and robes above and below.
translations.idiomatic: " From the first year of Chongde the Qing had already fixed regulations for caps and robes at every rank.

sentences.zh: 高宗一代，法式加詳，而猶於變本忘先，諄諄訓誡。

translations.literal: The Qianlong reign added detail to the forms, yet still earnestly admonished against forgetting the root and altering the source.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Gaozong reign the regulations grew more detailed, yet he still earnestly warned against forgetting one's origins and altering the foundation.

sentences.zh: 亦深維乎根本至計，未可輕革舊俗。

translations.literal: This also deeply considered fundamental long-range planning—not lightly to reform old custom.
translations.idiomatic: He also weighed this as a matter of fundamental long-term policy: old custom must not be lightly reformed.

sentences.zh: 祖宗成憲具在，所宜永守勿愆也。

translations.literal: The accomplished statutes of the ancestors are complete; they should be eternally kept without fault.
translations.idiomatic: The accomplished statutes of the ancestors stand complete; they should be kept forever without deviation.

sentences.zh: 茲就乾隆朝增改之制，以類敘次，而仍以初定者附見於篇。

translations.literal: Here the additions and revisions of the Qianlong reign are arranged by category, while the original regulations are still appended in the text.
translations.idiomatic: Here the additions and revisions of the Qianlong reign are arranged by category, with the original regulations still appended in the text.

sentences.zh: 皇帝朝冠，冬用薰貂，十一月朔至上元用黑狐。

translations.literal: The emperor's court cap: in winter scented marten fur is used; from the first day of the eleventh month to the Lantern Festival black fox is used.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's court cap: in winter it is made of scented marten fur; from the first day of the eleventh month through the Lantern Festival, of black fox.

sentences.zh: 上綴硃緯。

translations.literal: Vermilion tassels are affixed above.
translations.idiomatic: Vermilion tassels are affixed at the top.

sentences.zh: 頂三層，貫東珠各一，皆承以金龍四，餘東珠如其數，上銜大珍珠一。

translations.literal: The crown has three tiers, each strung with one Eastern pearl; all are borne on four golden dragons; the remaining Eastern pearls match that number; above is set one large pearl.
translations.idiomatic: The crown has three tiers, each bearing one Eastern pearl, all supported by four golden dragons with additional Eastern pearls to match; a large pearl is set on top.

sentences.zh: 夏織玉草或藤竹絲為之，緣石青片金二層，里用紅片金或紅紗。

translations.literal: In summer it is woven of jade grass or rattan and bamboo fiber; bordered with two layers of kingfisher-blue gilt strips; lined with red gilt strips or red gauze.
translations.idiomatic: In summer it is woven of jade grass or rattan and bamboo fiber, edged with two layers of kingfisher-blue gilt strips, and lined with red gilt strips or red gauze.

sentences.zh: 上綴硃緯，前綴金佛，飾東珠十五。

translations.literal: Vermilion tassels are affixed above; in front a golden Buddha is affixed, ornamented with fifteen Eastern pearls.
translations.idiomatic: Vermilion tassels are affixed above; in front a golden Buddha ornament set with fifteen Eastern pearls.

sentences.zh: 後綴舍林，飾東珠七，頂如冬制。

translations.literal: Behind is affixed a shel lin, ornamented with seven Eastern pearls; the crown is as in the winter style.
translations.idiomatic: Behind is affixed a shel lin ornament with seven Eastern pearls; the crown follows the winter design.

sentences.zh: 吉服冠，冬用海龍、薰貂、紫貂惟其時。

translations.literal: Auspicious-dress cap: in winter sea dragon, scented marten, or purple marten, according to the season.
translations.idiomatic: Auspicious-dress cap: in winter sea-dragon fur, scented marten, or purple marten, as the season requires.

sentences.zh: 上綴硃緯。

translations.literal: Vermilion tassels are affixed above.
translations.idiomatic: Vermilion tassels are affixed at the top.

sentences.zh: 頂滿花金座，上銜大珍珠一。

translations.literal: The crown has a full-flower golden seat; above is set one large pearl.
translations.idiomatic: The crown has a full-flower golden mount with one large pearl set on top.

sentences.zh: 夏織玉草或藤竹絲為之，紅紗綢里，石青片金緣。

translations.literal: In summer woven of jade grass or rattan and bamboo fiber; lined with red gauze silk; bordered with kingfisher-blue gilt strips.
translations.idiomatic: In summer it is woven of jade grass or rattan and bamboo fiber, lined with red gauze silk, and edged with kingfisher-blue gilt strips.

sentences.zh: 上綴硃緯。

translations.literal: Vermilion tassels are affixed above.
translations.idiomatic: Vermilion tassels are affixed at the top.

sentences.zh: 頂如冬吉服冠。

translations.literal: The crown is as in the winter auspicious-dress cap.
translations.idiomatic: The crown follows the winter auspicious-dress design.

sentences.zh: 常服冠，紅絨結頂，不加梁，餘如吉服冠。

translations.literal: Everyday-dress cap: red velvet knot crown, no ridge added; the rest as the auspicious-dress cap.
translations.idiomatic: Everyday-dress cap: a red velvet knot crown without a ridge; otherwise as the auspicious-dress cap.

sentences.zh: 行冠，冬用黑狐或黑羊皮、青絨，餘俱如常服冠。

translations.literal: Travel cap: in winter black fox or black sheepskin or blue velvet; the rest all as the everyday-dress cap.
translations.idiomatic: Travel cap: in winter of black fox, black sheepskin, or blue velvet; otherwise as the everyday-dress cap.

sentences.zh: 夏織藤竹絲為之，紅紗里緣。

translations.literal: In summer woven of rattan and bamboo fiber; red gauze lining and border.
translations.idiomatic: In summer woven of rattan and bamboo fiber with red gauze lining and edging.

sentences.zh: 上綴硃氂。

translations.literal: Vermilion yak-hair tassels are affixed above.
translations.idiomatic: Vermilion yak-hair tassels are affixed at the top.

sentences.zh: 頂及梁皆黃色，前綴珍珠一。

translations.literal: Crown and ridge are both yellow; in front one pearl is affixed.
translations.idiomatic: Crown and ridge are both yellow; a single pearl is affixed in front.

sentences.zh: 端罩，紫貂為之。

translations.literal: Formal over-robe: made of purple marten.
translations.idiomatic: Formal over-robe: made of purple marten fur.

sentences.zh: 十一月朔至上元用黑狐。

translations.literal: From the first day of the eleventh month to the Lantern Festival black fox is used.
translations.idiomatic: From the first day of the eleventh month through the Lantern Festival, black fox is used.

sentences.zh: 明黃緞里。

translations.literal: Lined with bright yellow satin.
translations.idiomatic: Lined with bright yellow satin.

sentences.zh: 左、右垂帶各二，下廣而銳，色與里同。

translations.literal: Left and right, two hanging sashes each; broad below and tapering to a point; color the same as the lining.
translations.idiomatic: On left and right, two hanging sashes each, broad at the bottom and tapering to a point, in the same color as the lining.

sentences.zh: 袞服，色用石青，綉五爪正面金龍四團，兩肩前後各一。

translations.literal: Dragon robe: color kingfisher-blue; embroidered with four roundels of five-clawed frontal golden dragons, one each on both shoulders front and back.
translations.idiomatic: Dragon robe: kingfisher-blue, embroidered with four roundels of five-clawed frontal golden dragons—one on each shoulder, front and back.

sentences.zh: 其章左日、右月，萬壽篆文，間以五色雲。

translations.literal: Its emblems: sun on the left, moon on the right, longevity seal script, interspersed with five-colored clouds.
translations.idiomatic: Its emblems are the sun on the left and moon on the right, longevity characters in seal script, and five-colored clouds interspersed.

sentences.zh: 春、秋棉、袷，冬裘、夏紗惟其時。

translations.literal: Spring and autumn cotton and lined; winter fur and summer gauze according to the season.
translations.idiomatic: In spring and autumn, cotton or lined versions; in winter fur and in summer gauze, as the season requires.

sentences.zh: 朝服，色用明黃，惟祀天用藍，朝日用紅，夕月用月白。

translations.literal: Court robe: color bright yellow; only for sacrificing to Heaven blue is used; for the morning sun ceremony red; for the evening moon ceremony moon-white.
translations.idiomatic: Court robe: bright yellow, except blue for sacrifices to Heaven, red for the morning sun rite, and moon-white for the evening moon rite.

sentences.zh: 披領及袖皆石青，緣用片金，冬加海龍緣。

translations.literal: Collar-cape and sleeves are all kingfisher-blue; borders use gilt strips; in winter sea-dragon borders are added.
translations.idiomatic: Collar-cape and sleeves are kingfisher-blue, edged with gilt strips; in winter sea-dragon fur is added to the borders.

sentences.zh: 綉文兩肩，前、後正龍各一，腰帷行龍五，衽正龍一，襞積前、後團龍各九，裳正龍二、行龍四，披領行龍二，袖端正龍各一。

translations.literal: Embroidery on both shoulders; front and back one frontal dragon each; at the waist five side-facing dragons; on the lapel one frontal dragon; on the pleats front and back nine round dragons each; on the skirt two frontal and four side-facing dragons; on the collar-cape two side-facing dragons; at the sleeve ends one frontal dragon each.
translations.idiomatic: Embroidered on both shoulders; one frontal dragon front and back; five side-facing dragons at the waist; one frontal dragon on the lapel; nine round dragons on the pleats front and back; on the skirt two frontal and four side-facing dragons; two side-facing dragons on the collar-cape; one frontal dragon at each sleeve end.

sentences.zh: 列十二章，日、月、星、辰、山、龍、華、蟲、黼黻在衣，宗彝、藻火、粉米在裳，間以五色雲。

translations.literal: The twelve emblems are arrayed: sun, moon, stars, constellations, mountains, dragons, floral emblem, insects, fu and fu patterns on the upper garment; ancestral vessels, flame, and rice powder on the skirt; interspersed with five-colored clouds.
translations.idiomatic: The twelve emblems are displayed: sun, moon, stars, constellations, mountains, dragons, floral emblem, insects, and fu patterns on the upper robe; ancestral vessels, flame, and rice powder on the skirt—all interspersed with five-colored clouds.

sentences.zh: 下幅八寶平水。

translations.literal: On the lower border the eight treasures and level water.
translations.idiomatic: The lower border bears the eight treasures and level water.

sentences.zh: 十一月朔至上元，披領及裳俱表以紫貂，袖端薰貂。

translations.literal: From the first day of the eleventh month to the Lantern Festival, collar-cape and skirt are both faced with purple marten on the outside; sleeve ends with scented marten.
translations.idiomatic: From the first day of the eleventh month through the Lantern Festival, the collar-cape and skirt are faced with purple marten and the sleeve ends with scented marten.

sentences.zh: 綉文兩肩，前、後正龍各一，襞積行龍六。

translations.literal: Embroidery on both shoulders; front and back one frontal dragon each; on the pleats six side-facing dragons.
translations.idiomatic: Embroidered on both shoulders; one frontal dragon front and back; six side-facing dragons on the pleats.

sentences.zh: 列十二章，俱在衣，間以五色雲。

translations.literal: The twelve emblems are arrayed, all on the upper garment, interspersed with five-colored clouds.
translations.idiomatic: All twelve emblems are on the upper robe, interspersed with five-colored clouds.

sentences.zh: 龍袍，色用明黃。

translations.literal: Dragon robe: color bright yellow.
translations.idiomatic: Dragon robe: bright yellow.

sentences.zh: 領、袖俱石青，片金緣。

translations.literal: Collar and sleeves are all kingfisher-blue; bordered with gilt strips.
translations.idiomatic: Collar and sleeves are kingfisher-blue, edged with gilt strips.

sentences.zh: 綉文金龍九。

translations.literal: Embroidered with nine golden dragons.
translations.idiomatic: Embroidered with nine golden dragons.

sentences.zh: 列十二章，間以五色雲。

translations.literal: The twelve emblems are arrayed, interspersed with five-colored clouds.
translations.idiomatic: The twelve emblems are displayed, interspersed with five-colored clouds.

sentences.zh: 領前後正龍各一，左、右及交襟處行龍各一，袖端正龍各一。

translations.literal: At the collar front and back one frontal dragon each; left, right, and at the crossing lapel one side-facing dragon each; at the sleeve ends one frontal dragon each.
translations.idiomatic: One frontal dragon at the collar front and back; one side-facing dragon each at left, right, and the crossing lapel; one frontal dragon at each sleeve end.

sentences.zh: 下幅八寶立水，襟左右開，棉、袷、紗、裘，各惟其時。

translations.literal: On the lower border the eight treasures and standing water; the lapel opens left and right; cotton, lined, gauze, and fur, each according to the season.
translations.idiomatic: The lower border bears the eight treasures and standing water; the front opens left and right; cotton, lined, gauze, and fur versions according to season.

sentences.zh: 常服褂，色用石青，花文隨所御，裾左右開。

translations.literal: Everyday-dress jacket: color kingfisher-blue; floral pattern according to what is worn; hem opens left and right.
translations.idiomatic: Everyday-dress jacket: kingfisher-blue, with floral pattern as worn; the hem opens left and right.

sentences.zh: 行褂，色用石青，長與坐齊，袖長及肘。

translations.literal: Travel jacket: color kingfisher-blue; length level with the seat when seated; sleeves reach to the elbow.
translations.idiomatic: Travel jacket: kingfisher-blue, length to the seat when seated, sleeves to the elbow.

sentences.zh: 常服袍，色及花文隨所御，裾四開。

translations.literal: Everyday-dress robe: color and floral pattern according to what is worn; hem with four openings.
translations.idiomatic: Everyday-dress robe: color and pattern as worn; four slits at the hem.

sentences.zh: 行袍同。

translations.literal: Travel robe: the same.
translations.idiomatic: Travel robe: the same.

sentences.zh: 行裳，色隨所御。

translations.literal: Travel skirt: color according to what is worn.
translations.idiomatic: Travel skirt: color as worn.

sentences.zh: 左右各一，前平，後中豐，上下斂。

translations.literal: One each left and right; flat in front; full at the center back; tapered above and below.
translations.idiomatic: One panel on each side; flat in front, full at the center back, tapered above and below.

sentences.zh: 橫幅石青布為之，氈、袷惟時。

translations.literal: The horizontal band is made of kingfisher-blue cloth; felt or lined according to the season.
translations.idiomatic: The waistband is kingfisher-blue cloth, felt or lined as the season requires.

sentences.zh: 冬用鹿皮或黑狐為里。

translations.literal: In winter deer hide or black fox is used for the lining.
translations.idiomatic: In winter lined with deer hide or black fox.

sentences.zh: 雨冠之制二：冬頂崇，前檐深；

translations.literal: Rain caps are of two styles: winter—high crown, deep front brim;
translations.idiomatic: There are two styles of rain cap: in winter a high crown and deep front brim;

sentences.zh: 夏頂平，前檐敞。

translations.literal: summer—flat crown, open front brim.
translations.idiomatic: in summer a flat crown and open front brim.

sentences.zh: 皆明黃色，月白緞里。

translations.literal: All are bright yellow; lined with moon-white satin.
translations.idiomatic: Both are bright yellow, lined with moon-white satin.

sentences.zh: 氈及油綢、羽緞惟其時。

translations.literal: Felt, oiled silk, and feather satin according to the season.
translations.idiomatic: Of felt, oiled silk, or feather satin as the season requires.

sentences.zh: 雨衣之制六，皆明黃色：一，如常服褂，而長與袍稱。

translations.literal: Rain garments are of six styles, all bright yellow: first, like the everyday-dress jacket, but length matching the robe.
translations.idiomatic: There are six styles of rain garment, all bright yellow. First: like the everyday-dress jacket, but long enough to match the robe.

sentences.zh: 自衽以下加博。

translations.literal: From the lapel downward it is widened.
translations.idiomatic: Below the lapel it is widened.

sentences.zh: 上襲重衣。

translations.literal: Above, double garments are worn over it.
translations.idiomatic: Worn over double under-layers.

sentences.zh: 領下為襞積。

translations.literal: Below the collar are pleats.
translations.idiomatic: Pleats fall below the collar.

sentences.zh: 無袖。

translations.literal: Without sleeves.
translations.idiomatic: Sleeveless.

sentences.zh: 斜帷相比，上斂，下遞豐。

translations.literal: Slanting panels joined together; narrow above, progressively fuller below.
translations.idiomatic: Slanting panels joined together, narrow at the top and progressively fuller below.

sentences.zh: 兩重俱加掩襟，領及鈕約皆青色。

translations.literal: Both layers have overlapping front flaps added; collar and fasteners are all blue.
translations.idiomatic: Both layers have overlapping front flaps; collar and fasteners are blue.

sentences.zh: 一，以氈及羽緞為之，月白緞里。

translations.literal: Second: made of felt and feather satin; lined with moon-white satin.
translations.idiomatic: Second: of felt and feather satin, lined with moon-white satin.

sentences.zh: 不襲重衣。

translations.literal: Not worn over double garments.
translations.idiomatic: Not worn over double under-layers.

sentences.zh: 餘制同。

translations.literal: The rest of the style is the same.
translations.idiomatic: Otherwise the same design.

sentences.zh: 領及鈕約如衣色，油綢為之，不加里。

translations.literal: Collar and fasteners match the garment color; made of oiled silk, without lining added.
translations.idiomatic: Collar and fasteners match the garment; of oiled silk, unlined.

sentences.zh: 鈕約青色。

translations.literal: Fasteners blue.
translations.idiomatic: Fasteners are blue.

sentences.zh: 一，如常服褂而加領，長與袍稱。

translations.literal: Third: like the everyday-dress jacket but with collar added; length matching the robe.
translations.idiomatic: Third: like the everyday-dress jacket with a collar added, length matching the robe.

sentences.zh: 氈羽緞為之，月白緞里。

translations.literal: Made of felt and feather satin; lined with moon-white satin.
translations.idiomatic: Of felt and feather satin, lined with moon-white satin.

sentences.zh: 領及鈕約如衣色。

translations.literal: Collar and fasteners match the garment color.
translations.idiomatic: Collar and fasteners match the garment.

sentences.zh: 一，如常服袍而袖端平，前施掩襠，油綢不加里。

translations.literal: Fourth: like the everyday-dress robe but with flat sleeve ends; overlapping front flap added in front; oiled silk without lining added.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth: like the everyday-dress robe with flat sleeve ends and an overlapping front flap; of oiled silk, unlined.

sentences.zh: 領用青羽緞，鈕約青色。

translations.literal: Collar uses blue feather satin; fasteners blue.
translations.idiomatic: Collar of blue feather satin; blue fasteners.

sentences.zh: 外加袍袖如衣色。

translations.literal: Worn over it, robe sleeves in the garment color are added.
translations.idiomatic: Outer robe sleeves in the garment color are worn over it.

sentences.zh: 一，如常服褂，長與坐齊。

translations.literal: Fifth: like the everyday-dress jacket; length level with the seat when seated.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth: like the everyday-dress jacket, length to the seat when seated.

sentences.zh: 氈、羽緞為之，月白緞里。

translations.literal: Made of felt and feather satin; lined with moon-white satin.
translations.idiomatic: Of felt and feather satin, lined with moon-white satin.

sentences.zh: 領及鈕約如衣色。

translations.literal: The collar and button-loops match the color of the garment.
translations.idiomatic: Collar and fastening loops were made to match the robe's color.

sentences.zh: 一，如常服袍而加領，長與坐齊。

translations.literal: First type: like an everyday robe but with an added collar, its length level with the seated figure.
translations.idiomatic: The first style resembled an ordinary robe with an added collar, cut to the length of a seated wearer.

sentences.zh: 油綢為之，不加里。

translations.literal: It is made of oiled silk, without lining.
translations.idiomatic: It was fashioned from oiled silk and left unlined.

sentences.zh: 袖端平，前加掩襠，領用青羽緞，鈕約青色。

translations.literal: The sleeve ends are plain; a front flap is added at the front; the collar uses azure feather-pattern satin; the button-loops are blue.
translations.idiomatic: The cuffs were plain; a front panel was added; the collar was of azure feather-satin, with blue fastening loops.

sentences.zh: 雨裳之制二，皆明黃色：一，左右幅相交，上斂下遞博。

translations.literal: There are two styles of rain skirt, all in bright yellow: the first has left and right panels crossing, narrow above and progressively wider below.
translations.idiomatic: Rain skirts came in two styles, both bright yellow: the first crossed its left and right panels, tapering above and widening toward the hem.

sentences.zh: 上前加淺帷為襞積。

translations.literal: Above the front a shallow valance is added to form pleated gathers.
translations.idiomatic: A shallow pleated valance was added above the front to form gathered folds.

sentences.zh: 兩旁綴以紐約，青色。

translations.literal: On both sides button-loops are attached, in blue.
translations.idiomatic: Blue fastening loops were attached on both sides.

sentences.zh: 腰為橫幅，用石青布，兩末削為帶系之。

translations.literal: The waist is a horizontal band of stone-blue cloth; both ends are cut into ties for fastening.
translations.idiomatic: The waist was a horizontal band of stone-blue cloth, its ends cut into ties for fastening.

sentences.zh: 一，前為完幅，不加淺帷，餘制同。

translations.literal: Second type: the front is a full panel, without the shallow valance; the remaining specifications are the same.
translations.idiomatic: The second had a full front panel without the pleated valance; all other specifications were identical.

sentences.zh: 朝珠，用東珠一百有八，佛頭、記念、背雲、大小墜雜飾，各惟其宜，大典禮御之。

translations.literal: Court prayer beads use one hundred and eight eastern pearls; Buddha-head, memorial, back-cloud, large and small pendants, and miscellaneous ornaments are each as appropriate; worn at great state ceremonies.
translations.idiomatic: Court prayer beads comprised one hundred and eight eastern pearls, with Buddha-head, memorial, back-cloud, and large and small pendant ornaments each fitted as befitting—worn at state ceremonies.

sentences.zh: 惟祀天以青金石為飾，祀地珠用蜜珀，朝日用珊瑚，夕月用綠松石，雜飾惟宜。

translations.literal: For sacrifices to Heaven lapis lazuli is used as ornament; for sacrifices to Earth the beads use amber; for the morning sun rite coral; for the evening moon rite turquoise; miscellaneous ornaments as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: For Heaven worship lapis lazuli was used; for Earth, amber; for the morning sun rite, coral; for the evening moon rite, turquoise—other ornaments as occasion required.

sentences.zh: 絛皆明黃色。

translations.literal: The cords are all bright yellow.
translations.idiomatic: All cords were bright yellow.

sentences.zh: 朝帶之制二，皆明黃色：一，用龍文金圓版四，飾紅藍寶石或綠松石，每具銜東珠五，圍珍珠二十。

translations.literal: There are two styles of court belt, all bright yellow: the first uses four gold round plaques with dragon patterns, adorned with red and blue precious stones or turquoise; each holds five eastern pearls, ringed by twenty pearls.
translations.idiomatic: There were two court belt styles, both bright yellow: the first bore four round gold plaques with dragon motifs, set with rubies, sapphires, or turquoise; each plaque held five eastern pearls ringed by twenty pearls.

sentences.zh: 左右佩帉，淺藍及白各一，下廣而銳。

translations.literal: Left and right suspended ribbons, one pale blue and one white; broad below and pointed.
translations.idiomatic: On left and right hung ribbons, one pale blue and one white, broad at the bottom and tapering to a point.

sentences.zh: 中約鏤金圓結，飾寶如版，圍珠各三十。

translations.literal: The middle clasp is a gilt round knot, ornamented like the plaques, each ringed with thirty pearls.
translations.idiomatic: The central clasp was a gilt round knot, jeweled like the plaques, each ringed with thirty pearls.

sentences.zh: 佩囊文綉、燧觿、刀削、結佩惟宜，絛皆明黃色，大典禮御之。

translations.literal: Embroidered pouch, fire-striker, girdle ornament, knife and whetstone, and knotted pendants as appropriate; the cords are all bright yellow; worn at great state ceremonies.
translations.idiomatic: Embroidered pouch, fire-striker, girdle plaque, knife and whetstone, and knotted pendants were added as suited—all on bright yellow cords—for state ceremonies.

sentences.zh: 一，用龍文金方版四，其飾祀天用青金石，祀地用黃玉，朝日用珊瑚，夕月用白玉，每具銜東珠五。

translations.literal: Second type: four gold square plaques with dragon patterns; their ornaments—for Heaven sacrifice lapis lazuli, for Earth yellow jade, for morning sun coral, for evening moon white jade; each holds five eastern pearls.
translations.idiomatic: The second style used four square gold plaques with dragon motifs: lapis lazuli for Heaven rites, yellow jade for Earth, coral for the morning sun, white jade for the evening moon—each holding five eastern pearls.

sentences.zh: 佩帉及絛，惟祀天用純青，餘如圓版朝帶之制。

translations.literal: Suspended ribbons and cords: only for Heaven sacrifice pure blue is used; the rest follow the round-plaque court belt regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Ribbon and cord color followed the round-plaque belt, except that for Heaven worship pure blue was used.

sentences.zh: 中約圓結如版飾，銜東珠四。

translations.literal: The middle round clasp is ornamented like the plaques and holds four eastern pearls.
translations.idiomatic: The central round clasp was jeweled like the plaques and bore four eastern pearls.

sentences.zh: 佩囊純石青，左觿、右削，並從版色。

translations.literal: The pouch is solid stone-blue; girdle ornament on the left, whetstone on the right; all follow the color of the plaques.
translations.idiomatic: The pouch was solid stone-blue; girdle plaque on the left, whetstone on the right—all matching the plaque ornaments.

sentences.zh: 吉服帶，用明黃色，鏤金版四，方圓惟便，銜珠玉雜寶各從其宜。

translations.literal: The festive dress belt uses bright yellow, with four gilt plaques, square or round as convenient; pearls, jade, and miscellaneous gems are each as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: The festive belt was bright yellow with four gilt plaques, square or round as preferred, set with pearls, jades, and gems as befitting.

sentences.zh: 左右佩帉純白，下直而齊。

translations.literal: Left and right suspended ribbons are pure white; straight and even below.
translations.idiomatic: White ribbons hung on either side, cut straight and even at the hem.

sentences.zh: 中約金結如版飾。

translations.literal: The middle clasp is a gold knot ornamented like the plaques.
translations.idiomatic: The central clasp was a gold knot matching the plaque ornaments.

sentences.zh: 餘如朝帶制，常服帶同。

translations.literal: The remainder follows the court belt regulations; the everyday belt is the same.
translations.idiomatic: All else followed the court-belt rules; the everyday belt was identical.

sentences.zh: 行帶，色用明黃，左右佩系以紅香牛皮為之，飾金花文鋄銀鐶各三。

translations.literal: The travel belt is bright yellow; left and right suspended attachments are made of red perfumed ox hide, each adorned with three gilt floral silver-gilt rings.
translations.idiomatic: The travel belt was bright yellow; left and right hung red perfumed leather fittings, each trimmed with three gilt floral silver rings.

sentences.zh: 佩帉以高麗布，視常服帶帉微闊而短，中約以香牛皮束，綴銀花文佩囊。

translations.literal: Suspended ribbons are of Korean cloth, slightly wider and shorter than those of the everyday belt; the middle clasp is bound with perfumed ox hide, with a silver floral-pattern pouch attached.
translations.idiomatic: Ribbons of Korean cloth, slightly wider and shorter than those on the everyday belt, were bound at center with perfumed leather and fitted with a silver-floral pouch.

sentences.zh: 明黃絛，飾珊瑚。

translations.literal: Bright yellow cord, adorned with coral.
translations.idiomatic: A bright yellow cord was set with coral.

sentences.zh: 結、削、燧、雜佩各惟其宜。

translations.literal: Knot, whetstone, fire-striker, and miscellaneous pendants are each as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: Knotted ornaments, whetstone, fire-striker, and other pendants were added as suited.

sentences.zh: 初制，皇帝冠用東珠寶石鑲頂，束金鑲玉版嵌東珠帶。

translations.literal: Under the original regulations, the emperor's crown used a peak inlaid with eastern pearls and gems; he girded a belt of gold-mounted jade plaques set with eastern pearls.
translations.idiomatic: Under the original regulations the emperor's crown bore a peak inlaid with eastern pearls and gems, and he girded a belt of gold-mounted jade plaques studded with eastern pearls.

sentences.zh: 康熙二十三年，定凡大典禮祭壇廟，冠用大珍珠、東珠鑲頂，禮服用黃色、秋香色、藍色五爪、三爪龍緞。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year of Kangxi it was fixed that for all great ceremonies at altars and temples, the crown uses a peak inlaid with large pearls and eastern pearls, and ceremonial dress uses yellow, autumn-scented, and blue five-claw and three-claw dragon satin.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 23 (1684), it was decreed that for great rites at altars and temples the crown would bear large pearls and eastern pearls, and ritual robes would be yellow, autumn-scented, or blue satin bearing five- or three-clawed dragons.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年，定禮服用石青、明黃、大紅、月白四色緞，花樣三色，圓金龍九，龍口珠各一顆。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng it was fixed that ceremonial dress uses stone-blue, bright yellow, great red, and moon-white satin in four colors; the pattern is in three colors, with nine round gold dragons, each with one pearl at the dragon's mouth.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 1 (1723), ritual robes were fixed as stone-blue, bright yellow, scarlet, or moon-white satin with a three-color motif of nine round gold dragons, each with a pearl at its mouth.

sentences.zh: 腰襴小團金龍九。

translations.literal: Nine small roundels of gold dragons at the waist hem.
translations.idiomatic: Nine small roundels of gold dragons adorned the waist hem.

sentences.zh: 周身五彩雲，下八寶平水、萬代江山。

translations.literal: Five-colored clouds all around; below, the Eight Treasures over level waves and myriad generations of rivers and mountains.
translations.idiomatic: Five-colored clouds circled the robe; below ran the Eight Treasures over level waves and the motif of rivers and mountains for ten thousand generations.

sentences.zh: 皇后朝冠，冬用薰貂，夏以青絨為之，上綴硃緯。

translations.literal: The empress's court crown: in winter scented sable is used; in summer it is made of blue velvet; vermilion woven tassels are attached above.
translations.idiomatic: The empress's court crown was scented sable in winter, blue velvet in summer, topped with vermilion woven tassels.

sentences.zh: 頂三層，貫東珠各一，皆承以金鳳，飾東珠各三，珍珠各十七，上銜大東珠一。

translations.literal: The peak has three tiers, each strung with one eastern pearl; all are borne on gold phoenixes, each adorned with three eastern pearls and seventeen pearls; above hangs one large eastern pearl.
translations.idiomatic: Its three-tiered peak held one eastern pearl per tier, each borne by a gold phoenix set with three eastern pearls and seventeen pearls, surmounted by one large eastern pearl.

sentences.zh: 硃緯上周綴金鳳七，飾東珠九，貓睛石一，珍珠二十一。

translations.literal: Seven gold phoenixes are attached around the vermilion band, adorned with nine eastern pearls, one cat's-eye, and twenty-one pearls.
translations.idiomatic: Seven gold phoenixes encircled the vermilion band, set with nine eastern pearls, one cat's-eye, and twenty-one pearls.

sentences.zh: 後金翟一，飾貓睛石一，珍珠十六。

translations.literal: One gold pheasant at the rear, adorned with one cat's-eye and sixteen pearls.
translations.idiomatic: At the rear stood one gold pheasant, set with one cat's-eye and sixteen pearls.

sentences.zh: 翟尾垂珠，凡珍珠三百有二，五行二就，每行大珍珠一。

translations.literal: Pearls hang from the pheasant tail; altogether three hundred and two pearls, in five rows of two tiers, each row with one large pearl.
translations.idiomatic: Pearls hung from the pheasant tail—302 in all—in five rows of two tiers, each row headed by one large pearl.

sentences.zh: 中間金銜青金石結一，飾東珠、珍珠各六，末綴珊瑚。

translations.literal: At the center one gold mount holds a lapis lazuli knot, adorned with six eastern pearls and six pearls; coral is attached at the end.
translations.idiomatic: At center a gold mount held a lapis knot with six eastern pearls and six pearls, terminating in coral.

sentences.zh: 冠後護領垂明黃絛二，末綴寶石，青緞為帶。

translations.literal: Behind the crown a neck-guard hangs two bright yellow cords, their ends adorned with gems; a blue satin band serves as the tie.
translations.idiomatic: From the rear neck-guard hung two bright yellow cords tipped with gems, with a blue satin band.

sentences.zh: 吉服冠，薰貂為之，上綴硃緯。

translations.literal: The festive dress crown is made of scented sable; vermilion tassels are attached above.
translations.idiomatic: The festive crown was of scented sable, topped with vermilion tassels.

sentences.zh: 頂用東珠。

translations.literal: The peak uses an eastern pearl.
translations.idiomatic: Its peak was set with an eastern pearl.

sentences.zh: 金約，鏤金雲十三，飾東珠各一，間以青金石，紅片金里。

translations.literal: The gold forehead band is gilt, with thirteen gilt clouds, each adorned with one eastern pearl, interspersed with lapis lazuli; the lining is red gilt.
translations.idiomatic: A gold forehead band bore thirteen gilt cloud motifs, each set with an eastern pearl and spaced with lapis, lined in red gilt.

sentences.zh: 後系金銜綠松石結，貫珠下垂，凡珍珠三百二十四，五行三就，每行大珍珠一。

translations.literal: At the rear is attached a gold mount holding a turquoise knot, with strung pearls hanging down; altogether three hundred and twenty-four pearls, in five rows of three tiers, each row with one large pearl.
translations.idiomatic: From the rear hung a turquoise knot in a gold mount, strung with 324 pearls in five rows of three tiers, each row led by one large pearl.

sentences.zh: 中間金銜青金石結二，每具飾東珠、珍珠各八，末綴珊瑚。

translations.literal: Two lapis lazuli knots in gold mounts at the center, each adorned with eight eastern pearls and eight pearls; coral is attached at the ends.
translations.idiomatic: Two lapis knots in gold mounts at the center, each set with eight eastern pearls and eight pearls and finished in coral.

sentences.zh: 耳飾，左右各三，每具金龍銜一等東珠各二。

translations.literal: Ear ornaments: three on each side; each is a gold dragon holding two first-grade eastern pearls.
translations.idiomatic: Ear ornaments: three on each side, each a gold dragon bearing two first-grade eastern pearls.

sentences.zh: 朝褂之制三，皆石青色，片金緣：一，綉文前後立龍各二，下通襞積，四層相間，上為正龍各四，下為萬福萬壽文。

translations.literal: There are three styles of court surcoat, all stone-blue with gilt borders: the first has embroidered standing dragons, two front and back; below, pleated gathers run through; four layers alternate; above are four front-facing dragons each; below are myriad felicity and longevity motifs.
translations.idiomatic: Three court surcoat styles, all stone-blue with gilt edging: the first bore two standing dragons front and back above gathered pleats in four alternating tiers—four front-facing dragons above, myriad felicity-and-longevity motifs below.

sentences.zh: 一，綉文前後正龍各一，腰帷行龍四，中有襞積。

translations.literal: Second type: embroidered front-facing dragons, one front and back; four striding dragons on the waist panel; pleated gathers in the middle.
translations.idiomatic: The second had one front-facing dragon front and back, four striding dragons at the waist panel, and gathered pleats at center.

sentences.zh: 下幅行龍八。

translations.literal: Eight striding dragons on the lower panel.
translations.idiomatic: Eight striding dragons adorned the lower panel.

sentences.zh: 一，綉文前後立龍各二，中無襞積。

translations.literal: Third type: embroidered standing dragons, two front and back; no pleated gathers in the middle.
translations.idiomatic: The third had two standing dragons front and back, with no central pleats.

sentences.zh: 下幅八寶平水。

translations.literal: The lower panel bears the Eight Treasures over level waves.
translations.idiomatic: The lower panel bore the Eight Treasures over level waves.

sentences.zh: 皆垂明黃絛，其飾珠寶惟宜。

translations.literal: All hang bright yellow cords; gem ornaments as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: All hung bright yellow cords with gemstones fitted as befitting.

sentences.zh: 朝袍之制三，皆明黃色：一，披領及袖皆石青，片金緣，冬加貂緣，肩上下襲朝褂處亦加緣。

translations.literal: There are three styles of court robe, all bright yellow: the first has stone-blue draped collar and sleeves with gilt borders; sable trim is added in winter; borders are also added above and below the shoulders where the surcoat overlaps.
translations.idiomatic: Three court robe styles, all bright yellow: the first had stone-blue draped collar and sleeves with gilt borders—sable trim in winter—and matching borders where the surcoat overlapped the shoulders.

sentences.zh: 綉文金龍九，間以五色雲。

translations.literal: Embroidered with nine gold dragons, interspersed with five-colored clouds.
translations.idiomatic: Nine gold dragons were embroidered among five-colored clouds.

sentences.zh: 中有襞積。

translations.literal: Pleated gathers in the middle.
translations.idiomatic: The center was gathered in pleats.

sentences.zh: 下幅八寶平水。

translations.literal: The lower panel bears the Eight Treasures over level waves.
translations.idiomatic: The lower panel showed the Eight Treasures over level waves.

sentences.zh: 披領行龍二，袖端正龍各一，袖相接處行龍各二。

translations.literal: Two striding dragons on the draped collar; one front-facing dragon on each sleeve end; two striding dragons at each sleeve join.
translations.idiomatic: Two striding dragons on the draped collar; one front-facing dragon on each cuff; two striding dragons where the sleeves joined.

sentences.zh: 一，披領及袖皆石青，夏用片金緣，冬用片雲加海龍緣，肩上下襲朝褂處亦加緣。

translations.literal: Second type: draped collar and sleeves are all stone-blue; gilt borders in summer; gilt cloud plus sea-dragon trim in winter; borders are also added above and below the shoulders where the surcoat overlaps.
translations.idiomatic: The second likewise had stone-blue collar and sleeves—gilt borders in summer, gilt cloud and sea-dragon trim in winter—with borders where the surcoat met the shoulders.

sentences.zh: 綉文前後正龍各一，兩肩行龍各一，腰帷行龍四。

translations.literal: Embroidery: one front-facing dragon front and back; one striding dragon on each shoulder; four striding dragons on the waist panel.
translations.idiomatic: One front-facing dragon front and back, one striding dragon on each shoulder, four striding dragons on the waist panel.

sentences.zh: 中有襞積。

translations.literal: Pleated gathers in the middle.
translations.idiomatic: The center was gathered in pleats.

sentences.zh: 下幅行龍八。

translations.literal: Eight striding dragons on the lower panel.
translations.idiomatic: Eight striding dragons adorned the lower panel.

sentences.zh: 一，領袖片金加海龍緣，夏片金緣。

translations.literal: Third type: collar and sleeves have gilt plus sea-dragon trim; in summer, gilt borders only.
translations.idiomatic: The third had gilt collar and sleeves with sea-dragon trim—gilt borders only in summer.

sentences.zh: 中無襞積。

translations.literal: No pleated gathers in the middle.
translations.idiomatic: It had no central pleats.

sentences.zh: 裾後開。

translations.literal: The hem is open at the back.
translations.idiomatic: The back hem was slit open.

sentences.zh: 餘俱如貂緣朝袍之制。

translations.literal: All the rest follows the sable-trimmed court robe regulations.
translations.idiomatic: All else followed the sable-trimmed court robe.

sentences.zh: 領後垂明黃絛，飾珠寶惟宜。

translations.literal: Bright yellow cords hang behind the collar; gem ornaments as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: Bright yellow cords hung behind the collar, jeweled as befitting.

sentences.zh: 龍褂之制二，皆石青色：一，綉文五爪金龍八團，兩肩前後正龍各一，襟行龍四。

translations.idiomatic: All cords were bright yellow.

sentences.zh: 朝裙，冬用片金加海龍緣，上用紅織金壽字緞，下石青行龍妝緞，皆正幅。

sentences.zh: 有襞積。

translations.literal: It has pleated gathers.
translations.idiomatic: It was gathered in pleats.

translations.literal: In summer it is made of gauze.
translations.idiomatic: In summer it was made of gauze.

sentences.zh: 太皇太后、皇太后冠服諸制與皇后同。

translations.literal: The Grand Empress Dowager and Empress Dowager: all crown and dress regulations are the same as the Empress.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Empress Dowager and Empress Dowager wore the same crown and dress as the Empress.

translations.literal: For the Grand Empress Dowager and Empress Dowager's crown and dress: whenever they receive congratulations at celebratory ceremonies, the crown uses a peak inlaid with eastern pearls; ceremonial dress uses yellow and autumn-scented five-claw dragon satin, embroidered satin, and brocade satin.

sentences.zh: 皇貴妃朝冠，冬用薰貂，夏以青絨為之。

translations.literal: The Imperial Noble Consort's court crown: in winter scented sable is used; in summer it is made of blue velvet.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Noble Consort's court crown was scented sable in winter, blue velvet in summer.

sentences.zh: 上綴硃緯。

translations.literal: Vermilion tassels are attached above.
translations.idiomatic: Vermilion tassels were attached above.

sentences.zh: 頂三層，貫東珠各一，皆承以金鳳，飾東珠各三，珍珠各十七，上銜大珍珠一。

sentences.zh: 硃緯上周綴金鳳七，飾東珠各九，珍珠各二十一。

translations.idiomatic: Seven gold phoenixes encircled the vermilion band, each set with nine eastern pearls and twenty-one pearls.

sentences.zh: 後金翟一，飾貓睛石一，珍珠十六，翟尾垂珠，凡珍珠一百九十二，三行二就。

translations.idiomatic: At the rear stood one gold pheasant set with one cat's-eye and sixteen pearls; pearls hung from its tail—192 in all—in three rows of two tiers.

sentences.zh: 中間金銜青金石結一，東珠、珍珠各四，末綴珊瑚。

translations.literal: One lapis lazuli knot in a gold mount at the center, with four eastern pearls and four pearls; coral is attached at the end.
translations.idiomatic: At center a gold mount held a lapis knot with four eastern pearls and four pearls, terminating in coral.

sentences.zh: 冠後護領垂明黃絛二，末綴寶石。

translations.literal: Behind the crown a neck-guard hangs two bright yellow cords; gems are attached at the ends.
translations.idiomatic: From the rear neck-guard hung two bright yellow cords tipped with gems.

sentences.zh: 青緞為帶。

translations.idiomatic: A blue satin band completed it.

translations.idiomatic: Her festive crown matched the Empress's.

translations.idiomatic: Her gold forehead band bore twelve gilt clouds, each set with an eastern pearl and spaced with coral, lined in red gilt.

translations.idiomatic: At the back hangs a gold-mounted turquoise boss from which pearl strands fall: two hundred and four pearls in all, arranged in three rows of three tiers.

sentences.zh: 領約、朝裙皆與妃同。

translations.literal: The collar clasp and court skirt are both the same as the Consort's.
translations.idiomatic: Her collar clasp and court skirt match those of a Consort.

sentences.zh: 采帨不繡花文。

translations.literal: The colored sash bears no embroidered floral pattern.
translations.idiomatic: Her ceremonial sash is left without embroidered floral designs.

sentences.zh: 餘同妃制。

translations.literal: The rest follows the Consort's regulations.
translations.idiomatic: All else conforms to the regulations for a Consort.

sentences.zh: 初制，皇貴妃、貴妃、妃、嬪冠服，凡慶賀大典，皇貴妃、貴妃冠頂用東珠十二顆，妃冠頂用東珠十一顆。

translations.literal: Under the initial regulations, for the crowns and robes of the Imperial Noble Consort, Noble Consort, Consort, and Imperial Concubine—at all celebratory great ceremonies—the Imperial Noble Consort and Noble Consort used twelve Eastern pearls on the crown top, and the Consort used eleven Eastern pearls on the crown top.
translations.idiomatic: Originally, at every grand celebratory rite, the crown tops of the Imperial Noble Consort and Noble Consort were set with twelve Eastern pearls, while a Consort's crown top bore eleven.

sentences.zh: 禮服用鳳凰、翟鳥等緞，五爪龍緞、妝緞、八團龍等緞。

translations.literal: Ceremonial robes used phoenix, pheasant, and other satins; five-claw dragon satin; decorated satin; and eight-roundel dragon satin.
translations.idiomatic: Their ceremonial robes were made of phoenix and pheasant satins, five-claw dragon brocade, decorated brocade, and eight-roundel dragon brocade.

sentences.zh: 至黃色、秋香色，自皇貴妃以下，概不許服。

translations.literal: Bright yellow and autumn-incense colors—from the Imperial Noble Consort downward—were generally not permitted to be worn.
translations.idiomatic: Bright imperial yellow and autumn-incense hues were forbidden to all ranks from the Imperial Noble Consort down.

sentences.zh: 嬪冠頂用東珠十顆，禮服用翟鳥等緞，五爪龍緞、妝緞、四團龍等緞。

translations.literal: The Imperial Concubine's crown top used ten Eastern pearls; ceremonial robes used pheasant and other satins, five-claw dragon satin, decorated satin, and four-roundel dragon satin.
translations.idiomatic: An Imperial Concubine's crown top bore ten Eastern pearls; her ceremonial robes were of pheasant satin, five-claw dragon brocade, decorated brocade, and four-roundel dragon brocade.

sentences.zh: 皇子朝冠，冬用薰貂、青狐惟其時。

translations.literal: The Prince's court crown: in winter, scented sable or blue fox, according to the season.
translations.idiomatic: A prince's winter court crown was of scented sable or blue fox, as the season required.

sentences.zh: 上綴硃緯。

translations.literal: Cinnabar tassels are affixed on top.
translations.idiomatic: Cinnabar tassels were mounted upon it.

sentences.zh: 頂金龍二層，飾東珠十，銜紅寶石。

translations.literal: The top is a two-tiered golden dragon, adorned with ten Eastern pearls, and set with a red gemstone.
translations.idiomatic: Its crown rose in two tiers shaped as a golden dragon, set with ten Eastern pearls and capped with a red gemstone.

sentences.zh: 夏織玉草或藤竹絲為之。

translations.literal: In summer it is woven of jade grass or rattan-and-bamboo silk.
translations.idiomatic: In summer it was woven from jade grass or rattan-and-bamboo silk.

sentences.zh: 石青片金緣二層，里用紅片金或紅紗。

translations.literal: It has two layers of azurite blue gold-trimmed edging; the lining uses red gold foil or red gauze.
translations.idiomatic: It was edged in two bands of azurite blue with gold thread, lined with red gold foil or red gauze.

sentences.zh: 上綴硃緯。

translations.literal: Cinnabar tassels are affixed on top.
translations.idiomatic: Cinnabar tassels were mounted upon it.

sentences.zh: 前綴舍林，飾東珠五。

translations.literal: At the front is affixed a shelin ornament, adorned with five Eastern pearls.
translations.idiomatic: A shelin ornament was fixed at the front, set with five Eastern pearls.

sentences.zh: 後綴金花，飾東珠四。

translations.literal: At the back is affixed a golden flower, adorned with four Eastern pearls.
translations.idiomatic: A golden flower was fixed at the rear, set with four Eastern pearls.

sentences.zh: 頂如冬朝冠，吉服冠紅絨結頂。

translations.literal: The top is like the winter court crown; the auspicious-dress crown has a red velvet knot top.
translations.idiomatic: Its crown matched the winter court crown; for auspicious dress the crown was topped with a red velvet knot.

sentences.zh: 端罩，紫貂為之，金黃緞里。

translations.literal: The formal surcoat is made of purple sable, with a golden yellow satin lining.
translations.idiomatic: His formal surcoat was of purple sable, lined with golden-yellow satin.

sentences.zh: 左右垂帶各二，下廣而銳，色與里同。

translations.literal: Left and right, two hanging ribbons each; broad at the bottom and tapering to a point, the same color as the lining.
translations.idiomatic: On either side hung two ribbons, wide below and sharp at the tip, in the same hue as the lining.

sentences.zh: 龍褂，色用石青。

translations.literal: The dragon surcoat uses azurite blue for its color.
translations.idiomatic: His dragon surcoat was azurite blue.

sentences.zh: 正面綉五爪金龍四團，兩肩前後各一，間以五色雲。

translations.literal: On the front are embroidered four five-claw golden dragons in roundels—one each on the shoulders, front, and back—interspersed with five-colored clouds.
translations.idiomatic: Its front was embroidered with four roundels of five-claw golden dragons—one on each shoulder and on the breast and back—amid five-colored clouds.

sentences.zh: 朝服之制二，皆金黃色：一，披領及裳俱表以紫貂。

translations.literal: There are two types of court dress, both golden yellow: the first has the collar cape and skirt both faced with purple sable.
translations.idiomatic: Court dress came in two forms, both golden yellow: in the first, collar cape and skirt were faced with purple sable.

sentences.zh: 袖端薰貂。

translations.literal: The sleeve cuffs are scented sable.
translations.idiomatic: The sleeve cuffs were of scented sable.

sentences.zh: 綉文兩肩前後正龍各一，襞積行龍六，間以五色雲。

translations.literal: The embroidery: one upright dragon each on the shoulders, front, and back; six coiling dragons on the pleats; interspersed with five-colored clouds.
translations.idiomatic: It was embroidered with an upright dragon on each shoulder and on the breast and back, six coiling dragons among the pleats, and five-colored clouds throughout.

sentences.zh: 一，披領及袖俱石青，片金緣，冬加海龍緣。

translations.literal: The second has the collar cape and sleeves all in azurite blue, with gold-trimmed edging; in winter, sea-otter fur trim is added.
translations.idiomatic: In the second, collar cape and sleeves were wholly azurite blue with gold-thread edging, and in winter trimmed with sea-otter fur.

sentences.zh: 綉文兩肩前後正龍各一，腰帷行龍四，裳行龍八，披領行龍二，袖端正龍各一。

sentences.zh: 下幅八寶平水。

translations.literal: The lower hem bears the Eight Treasures and level-water pattern.
translations.idiomatic: Along the lower hem ran the Eight Treasures and calm-water motif.

sentences.zh: 蟒袍亦金黃色，片金緣，綉文九蟒，裾左、右開。

translations.literal: The python robe is also golden yellow, with gold-trimmed edging; embroidered with nine pythons; the hem opens at left and right.
translations.idiomatic: His python robe was likewise golden yellow with gold-thread edging, embroidered with nine pythons, and slit at either side of the hem.

sentences.zh: 朝珠不得用東珠，餘隨所用，絛皆金黃色。

translations.literal: Court beads may not use Eastern pearls; the rest follows what is worn; all cords are golden yellow.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern pearls were forbidden on court beads; other materials were worn as appropriate, and all cords were golden yellow.

sentences.zh: 朝帶，色用金黃，金銜玉方版四，每具飾東珠四，中銜貓睛石一，左右佩絛如帶色。

translations.literal: The court belt is golden yellow, with four gold-clasp jade square plaques; each is adorned with four Eastern pearls, the center set with one cat's-eye stone; the hanging cords at left and right match the belt color.
translations.idiomatic: His court belt was golden yellow, bearing four square jade plaques in gold mounts—each set with four Eastern pearls and a central cat's-eye—with pendant cords to match.

sentences.zh: 吉服帶亦色用金黃，版飾惟宜，佩絛如帶色。

translations.literal: The auspicious-dress belt is also golden yellow; plaque ornamentation as appropriate; hanging cords match the belt color.
translations.idiomatic: His auspicious-dress belt was likewise golden yellow, its plaques ornamented as suited the occasion, with pendant cords to match.

sentences.zh: 雨冠、雨衣、雨裳，均用紅色，氈、羽紗、油綢，各惟其時。

translations.literal: The rain crown, rain robe, and rain skirt are all red, of felt, feather gauze, or oiled silk, each according to the season.
translations.idiomatic: Rain crown, rain robe, and rain skirt were all red, made of felt, feather gauze, or oiled silk as the season demanded.

sentences.zh: 初制，皇子冠服，凡慶賀大典，冠用東珠十三顆鑲頂，禮服用秋香等色，五爪、三爪龍緞，滿翠八團龍等緞，束金鑲玉嵌東珠帶。

sentences.zh: 親王朝冠，與皇子同。

translations.literal: The Imperial Prince's court crown is the same as the Prince's.
translations.idiomatic: An Imperial Prince's court crown matched that of an ordinary prince.

translations.idiomatic: Its peak was set with a red gemstone; those earlier granted a red velvet knot crown might wear that instead.

sentences.zh: 端罩，青狐為之，月白緞里，若曾賜金黃色者，亦得用之。

translations.literal: The formal surcoat is of blue fox, with a moon-white satin lining; if one had previously been granted golden yellow, that may also be used.
translations.idiomatic: His formal surcoat was of blue fox lined with moon-white satin; if golden yellow had been granted him, he might wear that as well.

sentences.zh: 補服用石青色，綉五爪金龍四團，前後正龍，兩肩行龍。

sentences.zh: 朝服、蟒袍藍及石青隨所用，若曾賜金黃色者，亦得用之。

translations.literal: Court dress and python robe may be blue or azurite as worn; if golden yellow had previously been granted, that may also be used.
translations.idiomatic: Court dress and python robe might be blue or azurite as appropriate; if golden yellow had been granted, that too was permitted.

sentences.zh: 餘與皇子同。

translations.literal: The rest is the same as the Prince.
translations.idiomatic: In all other respects his attire followed that of an ordinary prince.

sentences.zh: 朝珠、朝帶、吉服帶、雨冠、雨衣、雨裳，均與皇子同。

translations.idiomatic: His court beads, court belt, auspicious-dress belt, rain crown, rain robe, and rain skirt all matched those of an ordinary prince.

translations.idiomatic: The front shelin bore four inlaid Eastern pearls.

sentences.zh: 後金花，嵌東珠三。

translations.idiomatic: The rear golden flower bore three inlaid Eastern pearls.

translations.literal: The belt uses four gold-inlaid jade plaques, each inlaid with four Eastern pearls.
translations.idiomatic: The belt carried four gold-inlaid jade plaques, each set with four Eastern pearls.

sentences.zh: 順治九年，定冠頂共嵌東珠十，舍林、金花各增嵌東珠一。
