sentences.zh: 補服綉虎，餘與鎮國公同。

translations.literal: The rank-badge surcoat is embroidered with tigers; the rest is the same as the duke who guards the state's.
translations.idiomatic: His badge surcoat bore tiger embroidery; in all other respects his attire followed that of a duke who guards the state.

sentences.zh: 固倫額駙吉服冠，頂用紅寶石，戴三眼孔雀翎。

translations.literal: The Gulun Princess Consort's auspicious-dress crown uses a red gemstone on top and wears a three-eye peacock plume.
translations.idiomatic: A Gulun Princess Consort's auspicious-dress crown bore a red gemstone and a three-eye peacock plume.

sentences.zh: 吉服帶用金黃色。

translations.literal: The auspicious-dress belt uses golden yellow.
translations.idiomatic: His auspicious-dress belt was golden yellow.

sentences.zh: 餘與貝子同。

translations.literal: The rest is the same as the beizi's.
translations.idiomatic: In all other respects his attire matched that of a beizi.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年，定固倫額駙冠服與貝子同。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongde, it was fixed that the Gulun Princess Consort's crown and dress are the same as the beizi's.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Chongde the crown and dress of a Gulun Princess Consort were fixed to match those of a beizi.

sentences.zh: 順治八年，定冠頂嵌東珠六。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Shunzhi, it was fixed that the crown top was inlaid with six Eastern pearls.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Shunzhi the crown top was set with six Eastern pearls.

sentences.zh: 舍林嵌東珠二。

translations.literal: The shelin is inlaid with two Eastern pearls.
translations.idiomatic: The shelin bore two inlaid Eastern pearls.

sentences.zh: 金花嵌東珠一。

translations.literal: The golden flower is inlaid with one Eastern pearl.
translations.idiomatic: The golden flower bore one inlaid Eastern pearl.

sentences.zh: 帶用金鑲玉圓版四片，每片嵌東珠一。

translations.literal: The belt uses four gold-inlaid jade round plaques; each is inlaid with one Eastern pearl.
translations.idiomatic: The belt carried four gold-inlaid jade round plaques, each set with one Eastern pearl.

sentences.zh: 和碩額駙吉服冠，頂用珊瑚，戴雙眼孔雀翎。

translations.literal: The Heshuo Princess Consort's auspicious-dress crown uses coral on top and wears a double-eye peacock plume.
translations.idiomatic: A Heshuo Princess Consort's auspicious-dress crown bore coral and a double-eye peacock plume.

sentences.zh: 朝帶色用石青或藍，金銜玉圓版四。

translations.literal: The court belt color uses stone-blue or blue; four gold-clasp jade round plaques.
translations.idiomatic: His court belt was stone-blue or blue, with four round jade plaques in gold mounts.

sentences.zh: 餘與鎮國公同。

translations.literal: The rest is the same as the duke who guards the state's.
translations.idiomatic: In all other respects his attire followed that of a duke who guards the state.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年，定和碩額駙冠服與超品公同，如封爵在公以上者，仍照本階服用。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongde, it was fixed that the Heshuo Princess Consort's crown and dress are the same as the beyond-rank duke's; if enfeoffed rank is at duke or above, one still follows one's own rank in dress.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Chongde a Heshuo Princess Consort's crown and dress were fixed to match a beyond-rank duke's; yet if his enfeoffed rank stood at duke or higher, he still wore according to that rank.

sentences.zh: 順治八年，定冠頂嵌東珠四，舍林嵌東珠一。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Shunzhi, it was fixed that the crown top was inlaid with four Eastern pearls; the shelin was inlaid with one Eastern pearl.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Shunzhi the crown top was set with four Eastern pearls and the shelin with one Eastern pearl.

sentences.zh: 金花嵌綠松石一。

translations.literal: The golden flower is inlaid with one turquoise stone.
translations.idiomatic: The golden flower bore one inlaid turquoise stone.

sentences.zh: 帶用金鑲玉圓版四片，每片嵌貓睛石一。

translations.literal: The belt uses four gold-inlaid jade round plaques; each is inlaid with one cat's-eye.
translations.idiomatic: The belt carried four gold-inlaid jade round plaques, each set with one cat's-eye.

sentences.zh: 郡主額駙朝帶，用鏤金圓版四，每具飾綠松石一。

translations.literal: The Commandery Princess Consort's court belt uses four openwork gold round plaques; each is adorned with one turquoise stone.
translations.idiomatic: A Commandery Princess Consort's court belt bore four openwork gold round plaques, each set with one turquoise stone.

sentences.zh: 餘視武一品。

translations.literal: The rest follows the regulations for military officials of the first rank.
translations.idiomatic: In all other respects his attire followed military rank one.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年，定郡主額駙冠頂上銜紅寶石，嵌東珠一。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongde, it was fixed that the Commandery Princess Consort's crown top was set with a red gemstone on top and inlaid with one Eastern pearl.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Chongde a Commandery Princess Consort's crown peak was ordained to bear a red gemstone and one inlaid Eastern pearl.

sentences.zh: 帶用金圓版四片，嵌綠松石四。

translations.literal: The belt uses four gold round plaques, inlaid with four turquoise stones.
translations.idiomatic: The belt carried four gold round plaques set with four turquoise stones.

sentences.zh: 順治八年，定冠、帶與侯、伯同。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Shunzhi, it was fixed that the crown and belt are the same as the marquis's and earl's.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Shunzhi crown and belt were fixed to match those of a marquis or earl.

sentences.zh: 康熙元年，定用四爪蟒補服。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kangxi, it was fixed to use a rank-badge surcoat with four-claw python badges.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Kangxi the badge surcoat was fixed with four-claw python insignia.

sentences.zh: 縣主額駙冠服，視武二品。

translations.literal: The County Princess Consort's crown and dress follow the regulations for military officials of the second rank.
translations.idiomatic: A County Princess Consort's crown and dress followed military rank two.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年，定縣主額駙冠頂上銜紅寶石。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongde, it was fixed that the County Princess Consort's crown top was set with a red gemstone on top.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Chongde a County Princess Consort's crown peak was ordained to bear a red gemstone.

sentences.zh: 帶用金圓版四片，每片嵌紅寶石四。

translations.literal: The belt uses four gold round plaques; each is inlaid with four red gemstones.
translations.idiomatic: The belt carried four gold round plaques, each set with four red gemstones.

sentences.zh: 郡君額駙冠服，視武三品。

translations.literal: The Commandery Lady Consort's crown and dress follow the regulations for military officials of the third rank.
translations.idiomatic: A Commandery Lady Consort's crown and dress followed military rank three.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年，定郡君額駙冠頂上嵌藍寶石。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongde, it was fixed that the Commandery Lady Consort's crown top was inlaid with a blue gemstone on top.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Chongde a Commandery Lady Consort's crown peak was set with a blue gemstone.

sentences.zh: 帶用金圓版四片。

translations.literal: The belt uses four gold round plaques.
translations.idiomatic: The belt used four gold round plaques.

sentences.zh: 縣君額駙朝帶，用鋄金方鐵版四。

translations.literal: The County Lady Consort's court belt uses four gilt iron square plaques.
translations.idiomatic: A County Lady Consort's court belt used four gilt iron square plaques.

sentences.zh: 餘與武四品同。

translations.literal: The rest is the same as military officials of the fourth rank.
translations.idiomatic: In all other respects his attire matched military rank four.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年，定縣君額駙冠頂上銜水晶石。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongde, it was fixed that the County Lady Consort's crown top was set with rock crystal on top.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Chongde a County Lady Consort's crown peak was ordained to bear rock crystal.

sentences.zh: 帶用鋄金方鐵版四片。

translations.literal: The belt uses four gilt iron square plaques.
translations.idiomatic: The belt used four gilt iron square plaques.

sentences.zh: 鄉君額駙朝帶，用鋄金方鐵版四。

translations.literal: The Township Lady Consort's court belt uses four gilt iron square plaques.
translations.idiomatic: A Township Lady Consort's court belt used four gilt iron square plaques.

sentences.zh: 餘與武五品同。

translations.literal: The rest is the same as military officials of the fifth rank.
translations.idiomatic: In all other respects his attire matched military rank five.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年，定鄉君額駙冠用金頂。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongde, it was fixed that the Township Lady Consort's crown uses a gold top.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Chongde a Township Lady Consort's crown was fixed with a gold peak.

sentences.zh: 帶用鋄金圓鐵版四片。

translations.literal: The belt uses four gilt iron round plaques.
translations.idiomatic: The belt used four gilt iron round plaques.

sentences.zh: 並按固倫額駙若爵在貝子以上、和碩額駙爵在鎮國公以上者，冠服各從其品。

translations.literal: Moreover, according to this rule: if a Gulun Princess Consort holds rank at beizi or above, or if a Heshuo Princess Consort holds rank at duke who guards the state or above, crown and dress each follow that rank.
translations.idiomatic: Likewise, when a Gulun Princess Consort's own rank stood at beizi or higher, or a Heshuo Princess Consort's at duke who guards the state or higher, crown and dress followed that rank.

sentences.zh: 郡主額駙以下皆如之。

translations.literal: Commandery Princess Consort and below all follow this rule.
translations.idiomatic: Consorts of commandery princesses and below followed the same principle.

sentences.zh: 民公朝冠，冬用薰貂，十一月朔至上元用青狐。

translations.literal: The Commoner Duke's court crown: in winter scented sable is used; from the first day of the eleventh month until the Lantern Festival, blue fox is used.
translations.idiomatic: A Commoner Duke's court crown was scented sable in winter and blue fox from the eleventh month's first day through the Lantern Festival.

sentences.zh: 頂鏤花金座，中飾東珠四，上銜紅寶石，夏頂制同。

translations.literal: The top has an openwork gold base, adorned with four Eastern pearls in the middle, and set with a red gemstone on top; the summer crown follows the same design.
translations.idiomatic: Its peak rose from an openwork gold base set with four Eastern pearls and capped with a red gemstone; the summer crown followed the same design.

sentences.zh: 吉服冠頂用珊瑚。

translations.literal: The auspicious-dress crown top uses coral.
translations.idiomatic: The auspicious-dress crown peak used coral.

sentences.zh: 端罩，貂皮為之，藍緞里。

translations.literal: The formal surcoat is made of marten fur, with a blue satin lining.
translations.idiomatic: His formal surcoat was marten fur, lined with blue satin.

sentences.zh: 補服，色用石青，前後綉四爪正蟒。

translations.literal: The rank-badge surcoat uses stone-blue for its color; front and back are embroidered with four-claw upright pythons.
translations.idiomatic: His badge surcoat was stone-blue, with four-claw upright pythons embroidered on breast and back.

sentences.zh: 朝服，藍及石青諸色隨所用。

translations.literal: Court dress: blue and stone-blue in various shades as used.
translations.idiomatic: Court dress might be blue or stone-blue in whichever shade was worn.

sentences.zh: 披領及袖俱石青，片金緣，冬加海龍緣。

translations.literal: The collar cape and sleeves are both stone-blue, with gilt edging; in winter sea-dragon fur edging is added.
translations.idiomatic: Collar cape and sleeves were stone-blue with gilt banding, and in winter gained sea-dragon fur edging.

sentences.zh: 兩肩前後正蟒各一，腰帷行蟒四，中有襞積。

translations.literal: On the two shoulders, front and back, one upright python each; on the waist panel four coiling pythons; pleats in the middle.
translations.idiomatic: One upright python on each shoulder and on the breast and back, four coiling pythons on the waist panel, and pleats at the center.

sentences.zh: 裳行蟒八。

translations.literal: On the skirt are eight coiling pythons.
translations.idiomatic: The skirt bore eight coiling pythons.

sentences.zh: 十一月朔至上元，披領及裳俱表以紫貂，袖端薰貂。

translations.literal: From the first day of the eleventh month until the Lantern Festival, the collar cape and skirt are both faced with purple sable; the sleeve cuffs are scented sable.
translations.idiomatic: From the eleventh month's first day through the Lantern Festival, collar cape and skirt were faced with purple sable and the cuff ends with scented sable.

sentences.zh: 兩肩前後正蟒各一，襞積行蟒四，皆四爪。

translations.literal: On the two shoulders, front and back, one upright python each; on the pleats four coiling pythons—all four-claw.
translations.idiomatic: One upright python on each shoulder and on breast and back, four coiling pythons on the pleats—all four-clawed.

sentences.zh: 曾賜五爪蟒緞者，亦得用之。

translations.literal: Those once granted five-claw python satin may also use it.
translations.idiomatic: Those who had been granted five-claw python satin might wear it as well.

sentences.zh: 蟒袍，藍及石青諸色隨所用，通綉九蟒。

translations.literal: The python robe: blue and stone-blue in various shades as used; embroidered throughout with nine pythons.
translations.idiomatic: The python robe, in blue or stone-blue as worn, was embroidered throughout with nine pythons.

sentences.zh: 朝珠，珊瑚青金綠松蜜珀隨所用，雜飾惟宜。

translations.literal: Court beads: coral, lapis lazuli, turquoise, and amber as used; miscellaneous ornaments as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: Court beads might be coral, lapis lazuli, turquoise, or amber as befitting, with pendant ornaments fitted accordingly.

sentences.zh: 絛用石青色，朝帶色用石青或藍，鏤金玉圓版四，每具飾貓睛石一。

translations.literal: The cords use stone-blue; the court belt color uses stone-blue or blue; four openwork gold-and-jade round plaques, each adorned with one cat's-eye.
translations.idiomatic: His cords were stone-blue; his court belt stone-blue or blue, with four openwork gold-and-jade round plaques each set with one cat's-eye.

sentences.zh: 佩帉下廣而銳，吉服帶佩帉下直而齊，版飾惟宜。

translations.literal: The pendant sashes are broad below and taper to a point; on the auspicious-dress belt the pendant sashes are straight and even below; plaque ornaments as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: Court pendant sashes widened below and tapered to a point; on the auspicious-dress belt they hung straight and flush at the bottom, with plaque ornaments as befitting.

sentences.zh: 雨冠、雨衣、雨裳俱用紅色。

translations.literal: The rain crown, rain coat, and rain skirt all use red.
translations.idiomatic: Rain crown, rain coat, and rain skirt were all red.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年，定民公冠頂上銜紅寶石，中嵌東珠一。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongde, it was fixed that the Commoner Duke's crown top was set with a red gemstone on top, with one Eastern pearl inlaid in the middle.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Chongde a Commoner Duke's crown peak was ordained to bear a red gemstone with one Eastern pearl set in the middle.

sentences.zh: 帶用金圓版四片，嵌綠松石四。

translations.literal: The belt uses four gold round plaques, inlaid with four turquoise stones.
translations.idiomatic: The belt carried four gold round plaques set with four turquoise stones.

sentences.zh: 順治二年，定冠用起花金頂，上銜紅寶石，中嵌東珠三。

translations.literal: In the second year of Shunzhi, it was fixed that the crown uses an embossed gold top, set with a red gemstone on top, with three Eastern pearls inlaid in the middle.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Shunzhi the crown was fixed with an embossed gold peak bearing a red gemstone and three Eastern pearls in the middle.

sentences.zh: 帶用金鑲圓玉版四片，各嵌綠松石一。

translations.literal: The belt uses four gold-inlaid round jade plaques; each is inlaid with one turquoise stone.
translations.idiomatic: The belt carried four gold-inlaid round jade plaques, each set with one turquoise stone.

sentences.zh: 八年，定冠頂嵌東珠四，帶片各嵌貓睛石一。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, it was fixed that the crown top was inlaid with four Eastern pearls; each belt plaque was inlaid with one cat's-eye.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year the crown top was set with four Eastern pearls, and each belt plaque with one cat's-eye.

sentences.zh: 侯朝冠，頂鏤花金座，中飾東珠三，上銜紅寶石。

translations.literal: The Marquis's court crown has an openwork gold base on top, adorned with three Eastern pearls in the middle, and set with a red gemstone on top.
translations.idiomatic: A Marquis's court crown rose from an openwork gold base set with three Eastern pearls at its center and capped with a red gemstone.

sentences.zh: 朝帶鏤金銜玉圓版四，每具飾綠松石一。

translations.literal: The court belt has four openwork gold-clasp jade round plaques; each is adorned with one turquoise stone.
translations.idiomatic: His court belt bore four round jade plaques in openwork gold mounts, each set with one turquoise stone.

sentences.zh: 餘皆如公。

translations.literal: The rest is all the same as the Commoner Duke's.
translations.idiomatic: In all other respects his attire matched that of a Commoner Duke.

sentences.zh: 伯朝冠，頂鏤花金座，中飾東珠二，上銜紅寶石。

translations.literal: The Earl's court crown has an openwork gold base on top, adorned with two Eastern pearls in the middle, and set with a red gemstone on top.
translations.idiomatic: An Earl's court crown rose from an openwork gold base set with two Eastern pearls at its center and capped with a red gemstone.

sentences.zh: 朝帶鏤金銜玉圓版四，每具飾紅寶石一。

translations.literal: The court belt has four openwork gold-clasp jade round plaques; each is adorned with one red gemstone.
translations.idiomatic: His court belt bore four round jade plaques in openwork gold mounts, each set with one red gemstone.

sentences.zh: 餘皆如侯。

translations.literal: The rest is all the same as the marquis's.
translations.idiomatic: In all other respects his attire matched that of a marquis.

sentences.zh: 子朝冠，頂鏤花金座，中飾東珠一，上銜紅寶石，補服前後綉麒麟。

translations.literal: The Viscount's court crown has an openwork gold base on top, adorned with one Eastern pearl in the middle, and set with a red gemstone on top; the rank-badge surcoat has qilin embroidered front and back.
translations.idiomatic: A Viscount's court crown rose from an openwork gold base set with one Eastern pearl and capped with a red gemstone; his badge surcoat bore qilin embroidered on breast and back.

sentences.zh: 餘皆視武一品。

translations.literal: The rest all follows the regulations for military officials of the first rank.
translations.idiomatic: In all other respects his attire followed military rank one.

sentences.zh: 男朝冠，頂鏤花金座，中飾小紅寶石，上銜鏤花珊瑚。

translations.literal: The Baron's court crown has an openwork gold base on top, adorned with a small red gemstone in the middle, and set with openwork coral on top.
translations.idiomatic: A Baron's court crown rose from an openwork gold base set with a small red gemstone at its center and capped with openwork coral.

sentences.zh: 補服前後綉獅。

translations.literal: The rank-badge surcoat has lions embroidered front and back.
translations.idiomatic: His badge surcoat bore lions embroidered on breast and back.

sentences.zh: 餘皆視武二品。

translations.literal: The rest all follows the regulations for military officials of the second rank.
translations.idiomatic: In all other respects his attire followed military rank two.

sentences.zh: 順治二年，定侯、伯冠用起花金頂，上銜紅寶石，中嵌東珠一。

translations.literal: In the second year of Shunzhi, it was fixed that the marquis's and earl's crowns use embossed gold tops, set with a red gemstone on top, with one Eastern pearl inlaid in the middle.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Shunzhi marquises' and earls' crowns were fixed with embossed gold peaks bearing a red gemstone and one Eastern pearl in the middle.

sentences.zh: 帶用金鑲方玉版四片，每片嵌紅寶石一。

translations.literal: The belt uses four gold-inlaid square jade plaques; each is inlaid with one red gemstone.
translations.idiomatic: The belt carried four gold-inlaid square jade plaques, each set with one red gemstone.

sentences.zh: 六年，定冠頂嵌東珠二，帶改用圓玉版。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, it was fixed that the crown top was inlaid with two Eastern pearls; the belt was changed to round jade plaques.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year the crown top was set with two Eastern pearls and the belt changed to round jade plaques.

sentences.zh: 八年，定侯冠頂東珠三。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, it was fixed that the marquis's crown top has three Eastern pearls.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year a marquis's crown top was fixed at three Eastern pearls.

sentences.zh: 帶片各嵌綠松石一。

translations.literal: Each belt plaque is inlaid with one turquoise stone.
translations.idiomatic: Each belt plaque was set with one turquoise stone.

sentences.zh: 皇子福晉朝冠，頂鏤金三層，飾東珠十，上銜紅寶石。

translations.literal: The Imperial Son's Consort's court crown has a three-tier gilt top, adorned with ten Eastern pearls, and set with a red gemstone on top.
translations.idiomatic: An Imperial Son's Consort wore a court crown of three gilt tiers set with ten Eastern pearls and capped with a red gemstone.

sentences.zh: 硃緯。

translations.literal: Vermilion tassels.
translations.idiomatic: Vermilion tassels.

sentences.zh: 上周綴金孔雀五，飾東珠七，小珍珠三十九。

translations.literal: Five gold peacocks are attached around the top band, adorned with seven Eastern pearls and thirty-nine small pearls.
translations.idiomatic: Five gold peacocks encircled the upper band, set with seven Eastern pearls and thirty-nine small pearls.

sentences.zh: 後金孔雀一，垂珠三行二就。

translations.literal: One gold peacock at the rear; hanging pearls in three rows of two tiers.
translations.idiomatic: At the rear stood one gold peacock; pearls hung in three rows of two tiers.

sentences.zh: 中間金銜青金石結一，飾東珠各三，末綴珊瑚。

translations.literal: At the center one gold mount holds a lapis lazuli knot, each adorned with three Eastern pearls; coral is attached at the end.
translations.idiomatic: At center a gold mount held a lapis knot set with three Eastern pearls each, terminating in coral.

sentences.zh: 冠後護領垂金黃絛二，末亦綴珊瑚。

translations.literal: Behind the crown the neck-guard hangs two golden-yellow cords; coral is also attached at the ends.
translations.idiomatic: From the rear neck-guard hung two golden-yellow cords tipped with coral.

sentences.zh: 青緞為帶。

translations.literal: Blue satin serves as the band.
translations.idiomatic: A blue satin band completed it.

sentences.zh: 吉服冠頂用紅寶石。

translations.literal: The auspicious-dress crown top uses a red gemstone.
translations.idiomatic: The auspicious-dress crown peak was set with a red gemstone.

translations.literal: Military rank-nine badge surcoat: seahorses embroidered front and back.
translations.idiomatic: The military rank-nine badge surcoat bore seahorse embroidery front and back.

sentences.zh: 餘皆如文九品。

translations.literal: All the rest as civil rank nine.
translations.idiomatic: In all other respects his attire followed civil rank nine.

sentences.zh: 未入流冠服制如文九品。

translations.literal: Unranked officials: crown and dress regulations as civil rank nine.
translations.idiomatic: Unranked officials wore crown and dress on the model of civil rank nine.

sentences.zh: 凡雨冠，民公、侯、伯、子、男，一、二、三品文、武官，御前侍衛，乾清門侍衛，上書房、南書房翰林，批本處行走人員，皆用紅色。

translations.literal: For rain caps: commoner dukes, marquises, earls, viscounts, and barons; civil and military officials of ranks one through three; imperial guards before the throne; Qianqing Gate guards; Hanlin of the Upper and Southern Studios; and staff serving in the memorial-drafting office—all use red.
translations.idiomatic: Rain caps were red for commoner dukes through barons; civil and military officials of ranks one through three; imperial guards before the throne; Qianqing Gate guards; Upper and Southern Studio Hanlin; and staff of the memorial-drafting office.

sentences.zh: 四、五、六品文、武官，雨冠中用紅色，青緣。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials of ranks four through six: rain caps use red within, with blue edging.
translations.idiomatic: For civil and military officials of ranks four through six, rain caps were red within and blue-edged.

sentences.zh: 七、八、九、品文、武官，雨冠中用青色，紅緣。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials of ranks seven through nine: rain caps use blue within, with red edging.
translations.idiomatic: For civil and military officials of ranks seven through nine, rain caps were blue within and red-edged.

sentences.zh: 雨衣、雨裳，民公、侯、伯、子，文、武一品官，御前侍衛，各省督、撫，皆用紅色。

translations.literal: Rain capes and rain skirts: commoner dukes, marquises, earls, and viscounts; civil and military rank-one officials; imperial guards before the throne; provincial governors and governors-general—all use red.
translations.idiomatic: Rain capes and rain skirts were red for commoner dukes through viscounts; civil and military rank-one officials; imperial guards before the throne; and provincial governors and governors-general.

sentences.zh: 二品以下文、武官，皆用青色。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials from rank two down all use blue.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military officials from rank two down all wore blue.

sentences.zh: 其明黃色行褂，則領侍衛大臣、御前大臣、侍衛班長、護軍統領、健銳營翼領及凡諸臣之蒙賜者，皆得用之。

translations.literal: As for the bright imperial yellow traveling jacket, the chief guard minister, imperial guard minister, guard squad leaders, banner guard commanders, vanguard brigade wing commanders, and all officials granted it by the throne may use it.
translations.idiomatic: The bright imperial yellow traveling jacket might be worn by the chief guard minister, imperial guard minister, guard squad leaders, banner guard commanders, vanguard brigade wing commanders, and any official so granted by the throne.

sentences.zh: 凡帶，親王以下、宗室以上，皆束金黃帶。

translations.literal: For belts: from imperial princes down through the imperial clan upward, all wear golden yellow belts.
translations.idiomatic: From imperial princes down through the imperial clan, all wore golden yellow belts.

sentences.zh: 覺羅紅帶。

translations.literal: Jueluo use red belts.
translations.idiomatic: Jueluo wore red belts.

sentences.zh: 其金黃帶、紅帶，非上賜者，不得給予異姓。

translations.literal: Golden yellow belts and red belts, unless bestowed by the throne, may not be given to persons of other surnames.
translations.idiomatic: Golden yellow belts and red belts, unless bestowed by the throne, could not be given to persons of other surnames.

sentences.zh: 凡朝珠，王公以下，文職五品、武職四品以上及翰詹、科道、侍衛，公主、福晉以下，五品官命婦以上均得用。

translations.literal: For court beads: from princes and dukes down, civil officials of the fifth rank and above, military officials of the fourth rank and above, Hanlin and Imperial Diaries staff, censorate and supervising secretaries, guards, princesses, and princess consorts down through titled ladies of the fifth rank and above—all may use them.
translations.idiomatic: Court beads might be worn from princes and dukes down; by civil officials of the fifth rank and above and military officials of the fourth rank and above; by Hanlin and Imperial Diaries staff, censorate and supervising secretaries, and guards; and by princesses and princess consorts down through titled ladies of the fifth rank and above.

sentences.zh: 以雜寶及諸香為之。

translations.literal: They are made of assorted gems and various aromatics.
translations.idiomatic: They were made of assorted gems and various aromatics.

sentences.zh: 禮部主事，太常寺博士、典簿、讀祝官、贊禮郎，鴻臚寺鳴贊，光祿寺署正、署丞、典簿，國子監監丞、博士、助教、學正、學錄，除在壇廟執事及殿廷侍儀准用，其平時燕處及在公署，仍不得用。

translations.literal: Directors of the Ministry of Rites, doctors, registrars, prayer-readers, and ritual acolytes of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices; announcers of the Court of Imperial Entertainments; directors, assistant directors, and registrars of the Court of Imperial Household Revenue; and vice-directors, doctors, tutors, instructors, and recorders of the Directorate of Education—except when officiating at altars and temples or attending palace ceremonies, they may not use them in ordinary leisure or in government offices.
translations.idiomatic: Directors of the Ministry of Rites and the listed officials of the Courts of Imperial Sacrifices, Imperial Entertainments, and Imperial Household Revenue and the Directorate of Education might wear court beads only when officiating at altars and temples or attending palace ceremonies—not in ordinary leisure or at government offices.

sentences.zh: 凡孔雀翎，翎端三眼者，貝子戴之。

translations.literal: For peacock plumes: those with three eyes at the tip are worn by beizi.
translations.idiomatic: Peacock plumes with three eyes at the tip were worn by beizi.

sentences.zh: 二眼者，鎮國公、輔國公、和碩額駙戴之。

translations.literal: Those with two eyes are worn by dukes who guard the state, dukes who assist the state, and imperial sons-in-law of princesses of the second rank.
translations.idiomatic: Those with two eyes were worn by state-guarding and state-assisting dukes and by imperial sons-in-law of princesses of the second rank.

sentences.zh: 一眼者，內大臣，一、二、三、四等侍衛，前鋒、護軍各統領、參領，前鋒侍衛，諸王府長史，散騎郎，二等護衛，均得戴之。

translations.literal: Those with one eye: inner ministers; first-, second-, third-, and fourth-rank guards; vanguard and banner guard commanders and adjutants; vanguard guards; chief secretaries of princely households; masters of cavalry; second-rank bodyguards—all may wear them.
translations.idiomatic: Those with one eye might be worn by inner ministers; first- through fourth-rank guards; vanguard and banner guard commanders and adjutants; vanguard guards; princely household chief secretaries; masters of cavalry; and second-rank bodyguards.

sentences.zh: 翎根並綴藍翎。

translations.literal: At the plume root a blue plume is also attached.
translations.idiomatic: A blue plume was also attached at the root of the plume.

sentences.zh: 貝勒府司儀長，親王以下二、三等護衛及前鋒、親軍、護軍校，均戴染藍翎。

translations.literal: Chief masters of ceremony of a princely household, second- and third-rank bodyguards of princes and below, and vanguard, personal guard, and banner guard corporals—all wear dyed blue plumes.
translations.idiomatic: Chief masters of ceremony of a princely household, second- and third-rank bodyguards of princes and below, and vanguard, personal guard, and banner guard corporals all wore dyed blue plumes.

sentences.zh: 凡坐褥，親王冬用貂，夏用龍文赤繒。

translations.literal: For seat cushions: imperial princes use marten in winter and red silk with dragon pattern in summer.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial princes used marten seat cushions in winter and red dragon-pattern silk in summer.

sentences.zh: 世子、郡王冬用猞猁猻、緣貂，夏蟒文青繒。

translations.literal: Heirs apparent and commandery princes use lynx cat and marten-edged fur in winter, and blue python-pattern silk in summer.
translations.idiomatic: Heirs apparent and commandery princes used lynx cat and marten-edged fur in winter and blue python-pattern silk in summer.

sentences.zh: 貝勒冬用猞猁猻，夏青繒施采。

translations.literal: Beile use lynx cat in winter and blue silk with colored patterns in summer.
translations.idiomatic: Beile used lynx cat in winter and blue silk with colored patterns in summer.

sentences.zh: 貝子冬用白豹，夏采繒緣青繒。

translations.literal: Beizi use white leopard in winter and colored silk edged with blue silk in summer.
translations.idiomatic: Beizi used white leopard in winter and colored silk edged with blue silk in summer.

sentences.zh: 均藉紅白氈。

translations.literal: All are laid on red and white felt.
translations.idiomatic: All were laid on red and white felt.

sentences.zh: 鎮國公冬用全赤豹皮，夏青花赤繒。

translations.literal: Dukes who guard the state use whole red leopard fur in winter and blue-flowered red silk in summer.
translations.idiomatic: State-guarding dukes used whole red leopard fur in winter and blue-flowered red silk in summer.

sentences.zh: 輔國公冬用方赤豹皮，夏赤花皁繒。

translations.literal: Dukes who assist the state use square red leopard fur in winter and red-flowered black silk in summer.
translations.idiomatic: State-assisting dukes used square red leopard fur in winter and red-flowered black silk in summer.

sentences.zh: 均藉紅氈。

translations.literal: All are laid on red felt.
translations.idiomatic: All were laid on red felt.

sentences.zh: 鎮國將軍視一品，輔國將軍視二品，奉國將軍視三品，奉恩將軍視四品。

translations.literal: State-guarding generals are treated as rank one; state-assisting generals as rank two; state-supporting generals as rank three; grace-receiving generals as rank four.
translations.idiomatic: State-guarding generals were treated as rank one; state-assisting generals as rank two; state-supporting generals as rank three; and grace-receiving generals as rank four.

sentences.zh: 民公冬用全虎皮，夏皁繒。

translations.literal: Commoner Dukes in winter use whole tiger skins; in summer, black brocade.
translations.idiomatic: Commoner Dukes used whole tiger skins in winter and black brocade in summer.

sentences.zh: 侯、伯冬均用方虎皮，夏侯用緣花皁繒。

translations.literal: Marquises and earls in winter alike use square tiger skins; marquises in summer use bordered flower-pattern black brocade.
translations.idiomatic: Marquises and earls alike used square tiger skins in winter; marquises in summer used bordered flower-pattern black brocade.

sentences.zh: 伯用青雲繒。

translations.literal: Earls use blue-cloud brocade.
translations.idiomatic: Earls used blue-cloud brocade.

sentences.zh: 均藉紅氈。

translations.literal: All are set on red felt.
translations.idiomatic: All were set on red felt.

sentences.zh: 子、男各從其品。

translations.literal: Viscounts and barons each follow their rank.
translations.idiomatic: Viscounts and barons each followed their own rank.

sentences.zh: 固倫公主額駙視貝子。

translations.literal: A Gulun Princess Consort follows the regulations for a beizi.
translations.idiomatic: A Gulun Princess Consort followed beizi regulations.

sentences.zh: 和碩公主額駙視鎮國公。

translations.literal: A Heshuo Princess Consort follows the regulations for a duke who guards the state.
translations.idiomatic: A Heshuo Princess Consort followed the regulations for a duke who guards the state.

sentences.zh: 郡主額駙冬用貛，夏皁褐緣紅褐。

translations.literal: A Commandery Princess Consort in winter uses badger; in summer, black-brown bordered with red-brown.
translations.idiomatic: A Commandery Princess Consort used badger in winter and black-brown bordered with red-brown in summer.

sentences.zh: 均藉紅氈。

translations.literal: All are set on red felt.
translations.idiomatic: All were set on red felt.

sentences.zh: 郡君額駙視三品。

translations.literal: A Commandery Lady Consort follows the regulations for rank three.
translations.idiomatic: A Commandery Lady Consort followed rank-three regulations.

sentences.zh: 縣君額駙視四品。

translations.literal: A County Lady Consort follows the regulations for rank four.
translations.idiomatic: A County Lady Consort followed rank-four regulations.

sentences.zh: 鄉君額駙視五品。

translations.literal: A Township Lady Consort follows the regulations for rank five.
translations.idiomatic: A Township Lady Consort followed rank-five regulations.

sentences.zh: 文、武官一品冬用狼，夏紅褐。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials of the first rank in winter use wolf; in summer, red-brown.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military rank-one officials used wolf in winter and red-brown in summer.

sentences.zh: 二品冬用貛，夏紅褐緣皁褐。

translations.literal: Rank two in winter uses badger; in summer, red-brown bordered with black-brown.
translations.idiomatic: Rank two used badger in winter and red-brown bordered with black-brown in summer.

sentences.zh: 三品冬用貉，夏皁褐緣紅褐。

translations.literal: Rank three in winter uses raccoon dog; in summer, black-brown bordered with red-brown.
translations.idiomatic: Rank three used raccoon dog in winter and black-brown bordered with red-brown in summer.

sentences.zh: 四品冬用青山羊，夏皁布。

translations.literal: Rank four in winter uses blue mountain goat; in summer, black cloth.
translations.idiomatic: Rank four used blue mountain goat in winter and black cloth in summer.

sentences.zh: 均藉紅氈。

translations.literal: All are set on red felt.
translations.idiomatic: All were set on red felt.

sentences.zh: 五品冬用青羊，夏青布。

translations.literal: Rank five in winter uses blue sheep; in summer, blue cloth.
translations.idiomatic: Rank five used blue sheep in winter and blue cloth in summer.

sentences.zh: 六品冬用黑羊，夏椶色布。

translations.literal: Rank six in winter uses black sheep; in summer, palm-brown cloth.
translations.idiomatic: Rank six used black sheep in winter and palm-brown cloth in summer.

sentences.zh: 七品冬用鹿，夏灰色布。

translations.literal: Rank seven in winter uses deer; in summer, gray cloth.
translations.idiomatic: Rank seven used deer in winter and gray cloth in summer.

sentences.zh: 八品冬用狍，夏土布。

translations.literal: Rank eight in winter uses roe deer; in summer, homespun cloth.
translations.idiomatic: Rank eight used roe deer in winter and homespun cloth in summer.

sentences.zh: 九品冬用獺，夏與八品同。

translations.literal: Rank nine in winter uses otter; in summer, the same as rank eight.
translations.idiomatic: Rank nine used otter in winter and followed rank eight in summer.

sentences.zh: 均藉白氈。

translations.literal: All are set on white felt.
translations.idiomatic: All were set on white felt.

sentences.zh: 凡寒燠更用冠服，每歲春季用涼朝冠及夾朝衣，秋季用暖朝冠及緣皮朝衣。

translations.literal: As for changing court dress for cold and heat, each year in spring the cool court crown and lined court robe are used; in autumn the warm court crown and fur-trimmed court robe are used.
translations.idiomatic: Court dress changed with the seasons: each spring brought the cool court crown and lined court robe, and each autumn the warm court crown and fur-trimmed court robe.

sentences.zh: 於三、九月內，或初五日，或十五日，或二十五日，酌擬一日。

translations.literal: Within the third and ninth months, on either the fifth, fifteenth, or twenty-fifth day, one day is chosen as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: Within the third and ninth months, the change fell on whichever of the fifth, fifteenth, or twenty-fifth day was chosen.

sentences.zh: 均前一月由禮部奏請，得旨，通行各衙門一體遵照。

translations.literal: One month prior, the Ministry of Rites memorializes; upon receiving the decree, it is circulated to all offices for uniform compliance.
translations.idiomatic: One month beforehand the Ministry of Rites memorialized; once the decree was received, it was circulated to every office for uniform compliance.

sentences.zh: 凡文、武候補、候選官頂帶均與現任同。

translations.literal: As for civil and military officials awaiting appointment or candidacy, cap insignia and belts are the same as those of incumbents.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military officials awaiting appointment or candidacy wore the same cap insignia and belts as incumbents.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年，定都統、尚書冠頂上銜紅寶石。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongde, it was fixed that the crown tops of commanders-in-chief and ministers bore red gemstones.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Chongde it was ordained that commanders-in-chief and ministers should bear red gemstones on their crown peaks.

sentences.zh: 帶用金圓版四片，嵌紅寶石四。

translations.literal: The belt uses four round gold plaques, each inlaid with one red gemstone.
translations.idiomatic: The belt used four round gold plaques, each set with a red gemstone.

sentences.zh: 內大臣、大學士、副都統、護軍統領、前鋒統領、侍郎冠頂上銜藍寶石。

translations.literal: Grand ministers, grand secretaries, deputy commanders-in-chief, banner commanders, vanguard commanders, and vice ministers: their crown tops bear blue gemstones.
translations.idiomatic: Grand ministers, grand secretaries, deputy commanders-in-chief, banner commanders, vanguard commanders, and vice ministers bore blue gemstones on their crown peaks.

sentences.zh: 帶用金圓版四片。

translations.literal: The belt uses four round gold plaques.
translations.idiomatic: The belt used four round gold plaques.

sentences.zh: 一等侍衛、護衛參領、學士、滿啟心郎、郎中冠頂上銜水晶。

translations.literal: First-rank guards, guard company commanders, academicians, Manchu qishinlang, and bureau directors: their crown tops bear rock crystal.
translations.idiomatic: First-rank guards, guard company commanders, academicians, Manchu qishinlang, and bureau directors bore rock crystal on their crown peaks.

sentences.zh: 帶用鋄金鐵版四片。

translations.literal: The belt uses four gilt iron plaques.
translations.idiomatic: The belt used four gilt iron plaques.

sentences.zh: 二等、三等侍衛，護衛，佐領，漢啟心郎，員外郎冠用金頂。

translations.literal: Second- and third-rank guards, guards, company commanders, Han qishinlang, and assistant bureau directors use gold crown tops.
translations.idiomatic: Second- and third-rank guards, guards, company commanders, Han qishinlang, and assistant bureau directors wore gold crown peaks.

sentences.zh: 帶用鋄金圓鐵版四片。

translations.literal: The belt uses four round gilt iron plaques.
translations.idiomatic: The belt used four round gilt iron plaques.

sentences.zh: 護軍校、主事冠用金頂。

translations.literal: Banner corporals and section chiefs use gold crown tops.
translations.idiomatic: Banner corporals and section chiefs wore gold crown peaks.

sentences.zh: 帶用鋄金圓鐵版二片。

translations.literal: The belt uses two round gilt iron plaques.
translations.idiomatic: The belt used two round gilt iron plaques.

sentences.zh: 順治二年，定一品官冠用起花金頂，上銜紅寶石，中嵌東珠一。

translations.literal: In the second year of Shunzhi, it was fixed that rank-one officials' caps use embossed gold tops, set with red gemstones on top and one Eastern pearl inlaid in the center.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Shunzhi rank-one caps were fixed with embossed gold peaks bearing a red gemstone above and one Eastern pearl at the center.

sentences.zh: 帶用金鑲方玉版四片，每片嵌紅寶石一。

translations.literal: The belt uses four square jade plaques in gold mounts, each inlaid with one red gemstone.
translations.idiomatic: The belt used four square jade plaques in gold mounts, each set with a red gemstone.

sentences.zh: 二品官冠用起花金頂，上銜紅寶石，中嵌小紅寶石。

translations.literal: Rank-two officials' caps use embossed gold tops, set with red gemstones on top and small red gemstones inlaid in the center.
translations.idiomatic: Rank-two caps used embossed gold peaks bearing a red gemstone above and a small red gemstone at the center.

sentences.zh: 帶用起花金圓版四片，嵌紅寶石一。

translations.literal: The belt uses four embossed gold round plaques, each inlaid with one red gemstone.
translations.idiomatic: The belt used four embossed gold round plaques, each set with a red gemstone.

sentences.zh: 三品官冠用起花金頂，上銜紅寶石，中嵌小藍寶石。

translations.literal: Rank-three officials' caps use embossed gold tops, set with red gemstones on top and small blue gemstones inlaid in the center.
translations.idiomatic: Rank-three caps used embossed gold peaks bearing a red gemstone above and a small blue gemstone at the center.

sentences.zh: 帶用起花金圓版四片。

translations.literal: The belt uses four embossed gold round plaques.
translations.idiomatic: The belt used four embossed gold round plaques.

sentences.zh: 四品官冠用起花金頂，上銜藍寶石，中嵌小藍寶石。

translations.literal: Rank-four officials' caps use embossed gold tops, set with blue gemstones on top and small blue gemstones inlaid in the center.
translations.idiomatic: Rank-four caps used embossed gold peaks bearing a blue gemstone above and a small blue gemstone at the center.

sentences.zh: 帶用起花金圓版四片，銀鑲邊。

translations.literal: The belt uses four embossed gold round plaques with silver edging.
translations.idiomatic: The belt used four embossed gold round plaques with silver edging.

sentences.zh: 五品官冠用起花金頂，上銜水晶，中嵌小藍寶石。

translations.literal: Rank-five officials' caps use embossed gold tops, set with rock crystal on top and small blue gemstones inlaid in the center.
translations.idiomatic: Rank-five caps used embossed gold peaks bearing rock crystal above and a small blue gemstone at the center.

sentences.zh: 帶用素金圓版四片，銀鑲邊。

translations.literal: The belt uses four plain gold round plaques with silver edging.
translations.idiomatic: The belt used four plain gold round plaques with silver edging.

sentences.zh: 六品官冠用起花金頂，上銜水晶。

translations.literal: Rank-six officials' caps use embossed gold tops, set with rock crystal on top.
translations.idiomatic: Rank-six caps used embossed gold peaks bearing rock crystal.

sentences.zh: 帶用玳瑁圓版四片，銀鑲邊。

translations.literal: The belt uses four tortoiseshell round plaques with silver edging.
translations.idiomatic: The belt used four tortoiseshell round plaques with silver edging.

sentences.zh: 七品官冠用起花金頂，中嵌小藍寶石。

translations.literal: Rank-seven officials' caps use embossed gold tops with small blue gemstones inlaid in the center.
translations.idiomatic: Rank-seven caps used embossed gold peaks with a small blue gemstone at the center.

sentences.zh: 帶用素銀圓版四片。

translations.literal: The belt uses four plain silver round plaques.
translations.idiomatic: The belt used four plain silver round plaques.

sentences.zh: 八品官冠用起花金頂。

translations.literal: Rank-eight officials' caps use embossed gold tops.
translations.idiomatic: Rank-eight caps used embossed gold peaks.

sentences.zh: 帶用明羊角圓版四片，銀鑲邊。

translations.literal: The belt uses four translucent ram's-horn round plaques with silver edging.
translations.idiomatic: The belt used four translucent ram's-horn round plaques with silver edging.

sentences.zh: 九品官冠用起花銀頂。

translations.literal: Rank-nine officials' caps use embossed silver tops.
translations.idiomatic: Rank-nine caps used embossed silver peaks.

sentences.zh: 帶用烏角圓版四片，銀鑲邊。

translations.literal: The belt uses four black-horn round plaques with silver edging.
translations.idiomatic: The belt used four black-horn round plaques with silver edging.

sentences.zh: 順治九年，定武官補服一品、二品用獅，三品用虎，四品用豹。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Shunzhi, it was fixed that military officials' badge surcoats of ranks one and two use lions, rank three uses tigers, and rank four uses leopards.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Shunzhi military badge surcoats were fixed: ranks one and two bore lions, rank three tigers, and rank four leopards.

sentences.zh: 又雍正五年，定奉國將軍及三品官冠用起花珊瑚頂。

translations.literal: Moreover, in the fifth year of Yongzheng, it was fixed that State Supporter Generals and rank-three officials' caps use embossed coral tops.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Yongzheng it was further ordained that State Supporter Generals and rank-three officials should wear embossed coral crown peaks.

sentences.zh: 六品官冠用水晶石頂。

translations.literal: Rank-six officials' caps use rock-crystal tops.
translations.idiomatic: Rank-six caps used rock-crystal peaks.

sentences.zh: 一品命婦朝冠，頂鏤花金座，中飾東珠一，上銜紅寶石。

translations.literal: A first-rank titled lady's court crown has an openwork floral golden mount, adorned with one Eastern pearl in the center and set with a red gemstone on top.
translations.idiomatic: A first-rank titled lady's court crown rose from an openwork floral golden mount set with one Eastern pearl and capped with a red gemstone.

sentences.zh: 餘皆如民公夫人。

translations.literal: All the rest is the same as the Commoner Duke's wife.
translations.idiomatic: In all other respects her attire followed the Commoner Duke's wife.

sentences.zh: 二品命婦朝冠，頂鏤花金座，中飾紅寶石一，上銜鏤花珊瑚。

translations.literal: A second-rank titled lady's court crown has an openwork floral golden mount, adorned with one red gemstone in the center and set with openwork coral on top.
translations.idiomatic: A second-rank titled lady's court crown rose from an openwork floral golden mount set with one red gemstone and capped with openwork coral.

sentences.zh: 吉服冠頂亦用鏤花珊瑚。

translations.literal: The auspicious-dress crown top also uses openwork coral.
translations.idiomatic: The auspicious-dress crown peak likewise used openwork coral.

sentences.zh: 餘皆如一品命婦。

translations.literal: All the rest is the same as a first-rank titled lady's.
translations.idiomatic: In all other respects her attire followed that of a first-rank titled lady.

sentences.zh: 三品命婦朝冠，頂鏤花金座，中飾紅寶石一，上銜藍寶石。

translations.literal: A third-rank titled lady's court crown has an openwork floral golden mount, adorned with one red gemstone in the center and set with a blue gemstone on top.
translations.idiomatic: A third-rank titled lady's court crown rose from an openwork floral golden mount set with one red gemstone and capped with a blue gemstone.

sentences.zh: 吉服冠頂亦用藍寶石。

translations.literal: The auspicious-dress crown top also uses a blue gemstone.
translations.idiomatic: The auspicious-dress crown peak likewise used a blue gemstone.

sentences.zh: 餘皆如二品命婦。

translations.literal: All the rest is the same as a second-rank titled lady's.
translations.idiomatic: In all other respects her attire followed that of a second-rank titled lady.

sentences.zh: 四品命婦朝冠，頂鏤花金座，中飾小藍寶石一，上銜青金石。

translations.literal: A fourth-rank titled lady's court crown has an openwork floral golden mount, adorned with one small blue gemstone in the center and set with lapis lazuli on top.
translations.idiomatic: A fourth-rank titled lady's court crown rose from an openwork floral golden mount set with one small blue gemstone and capped with lapis lazuli.

sentences.zh: 吉服冠頂亦用青金石，朝袍片金緣，綉文前後行蟒各二，中無襞積。

translations.literal: The auspicious-dress crown top also uses lapis lazuli; the court robe has gilt edging; the embroidery shows two coiling pythons front and back, with no pleats in the center.
translations.idiomatic: The auspicious-dress crown peak likewise used lapis lazuli; her court robe bore gilt edging and was embroidered with two coiling pythons front and back, without pleats at the center.

sentences.zh: 後垂石青絛，雜飾惟宜。

translations.literal: At the rear hangs a stone-blue cord; miscellaneous ornaments as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: A stone-blue cord hung at the rear, with such ornaments as were fitting.

sentences.zh: 蟒袍通綉四爪八蟒。

translations.literal: The python robe is embroidered throughout with four-claw eight-pythons.
translations.idiomatic: Her python robe was embroidered throughout with eight four-claw pythons.

sentences.zh: 朝裙片金緣，上用綠緞，下石青行蟒妝緞，均正幅，有襞積。

translations.literal: The court skirt has gilt edging; the upper part uses green satin, the lower part stone-blue coiling-python brocaded satin; both are full panels, with pleats.
translations.idiomatic: Her court skirt bore gilt edging: green satin above and stone-blue coiling-python brocaded satin below, both in full panels with pleats.

sentences.zh: 餘皆如三品命婦。

translations.literal: All the rest is the same as a third-rank titled lady's.
translations.idiomatic: In all other respects her attire followed that of a third-rank titled lady.

sentences.zh: 五品命婦朝冠，頂鏤花金座，中飾小藍寶石一，上銜水晶。

translations.literal: A fifth-rank titled lady's court crown has an openwork floral golden mount, adorned with one small blue gemstone in the center and set with rock crystal on top.
translations.idiomatic: A fifth-rank titled lady's court crown rose from an openwork floral golden mount set with one small blue gemstone and capped with rock crystal.

sentences.zh: 吉服冠頂亦用水晶。

translations.literal: The auspicious-dress crown top also uses rock crystal.
translations.idiomatic: The auspicious-dress crown peak likewise used rock crystal.

sentences.zh: 餘皆如四品命婦。

translations.literal: All the rest is the same as a fourth-rank titled lady's.
translations.idiomatic: In all other respects her attire followed that of a fourth-rank titled lady.

sentences.zh: 六品命婦朝冠，頂鏤花金座，中飾小藍寶石一，上銜硨磲。

translations.literal: A sixth-rank titled lady's court crown has an openwork floral golden mount, adorned with one small blue gemstone in the center and set with tridacna on top.
translations.idiomatic: A sixth-rank titled lady's court crown rose from an openwork floral golden mount set with one small blue gemstone and capped with tridacna.

sentences.zh: 吉服冠頂亦用硨磲。

translations.literal: The auspicious-dress crown top also uses tridacna.
translations.idiomatic: The auspicious-dress crown peak likewise used tridacna.

sentences.zh: 餘皆如五品命婦。

translations.literal: All the rest is the same as a fifth-rank titled lady's.
translations.idiomatic: In all other respects her attire followed that of a fifth-rank titled lady.

sentences.zh: 七品命婦朝冠，頂鏤花金座，中飾小水晶一，上銜素金。

translations.literal: A seventh-rank titled lady's court crown has an openwork floral golden mount, adorned with one small rock crystal in the center and set with plain gold on top.
translations.idiomatic: A seventh-rank titled lady's court crown rose from an openwork floral golden mount set with one small rock crystal and capped with plain gold.

sentences.zh: 吉服冠頂亦用素金。

translations.literal: The auspicious-dress crown top also uses plain gold.
translations.idiomatic: The auspicious-dress crown peak likewise used plain gold.

sentences.zh: 蟒袍通綉五蟒。

translations.literal: The python robe is embroidered throughout with five pythons.
translations.idiomatic: Her python robe was embroidered throughout with five pythons.

sentences.zh: 餘皆如六品命婦。

translations.literal: All the rest is the same as a sixth-rank titled lady's.
translations.idiomatic: In all other respects her attire followed that of a sixth-rank titled lady.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年，定命婦冠、服各視其夫官階。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongde, it was fixed that titled ladies' caps and dress each follow their husbands' official rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Chongde it was ordained that titled ladies' caps and dress should follow their husbands' official rank.

sentences.zh: 皇后侍從婦女冠用金頂，上銜紅寶石。

translations.literal: Attendant women of the empress use gold crown tops, set with red gemstones on top.
translations.idiomatic: The empress's attendant women wore gold crown peaks bearing red gemstones.

sentences.zh: 貴妃侍從婦女冠用金頂，上銜水晶石。

translations.literal: Attendant women of the imperial noble consort use gold crown tops, set with rock crystal on top.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial noble consort's attendant women wore gold crown peaks bearing rock crystal.

sentences.zh: 親、郡王妃侍從婦女與妃侍從婦女同。

translations.literal: Attendant women of imperial and commandery princess consorts are the same as those of the consort's attendants.
translations.idiomatic: Attendant women of imperial and commandery princess consorts followed those of the consort's attendants.

sentences.zh: 貝勒夫人侍從婦女冠用金頂。

translations.literal: Attendant women of a beile's wife use gold crown tops.
translations.idiomatic: A beile's wife's attendant women wore gold crown peaks.

sentences.zh: 貝子夫人侍從婦女冠不用頂。

translations.literal: Attendant women of a beizi's wife do not use crown tops.
translations.idiomatic: A beizi's wife's attendant women wore no crown peak.

sentences.zh: 首飾嵌珍珠、寶石、綠松石。

translations.literal: Head ornaments are inlaid with pearls, gemstones, and turquoise.
translations.idiomatic: Head ornaments were inlaid with pearls, gemstones, and turquoise.

sentences.zh: 會試中式貢士朝冠，頂鏤花金座，上銜金三枝九葉。

translations.literal: A metropolitan examination successful tribute scholar's court crown has an openwork floral golden mount, set with three golden branches of nine leaves on top.
translations.idiomatic: A successful metropolitan tribute scholar's court crown rose from an openwork floral golden mount surmounted by three golden branches of nine leaves.

sentences.zh: 吉服冠頂用素金。

translations.literal: The auspicious-dress crown top uses plain gold.
translations.idiomatic: The auspicious-dress crown peak used plain gold.

sentences.zh: 狀元金頂，上銜水晶。

translations.literal: The top graduate uses a gold crown top, set with rock crystal on top.
translations.idiomatic: The top graduate wore a gold crown peak bearing rock crystal.

sentences.zh: 授職後，各視其品。

translations.literal: After receiving appointment, each follows his rank.
translations.idiomatic: After receiving appointment, each followed his rank.

sentences.zh: 舉人公服冠，頂鏤花銀座，上銜金雀。

translations.literal: A provincial graduate's public-service cap has an openwork silver mount, set with a golden sparrow on top.
translations.idiomatic: A provincial graduate's public-service cap rose from an openwork silver mount surmounted by a golden sparrow.

sentences.zh: 公服袍，青綢藍緣。

translations.literal: The public-service robe is blue silk with blue edging.
translations.idiomatic: The public-service robe was blue silk with blue edging.

sentences.zh: 披領如袍式。

translations.literal: The collar cape follows the robe style.
translations.idiomatic: The collar cape followed the robe style.

sentences.zh: 公服帶，制如文八品朝帶。

translations.literal: The public-service belt follows the design of a civil rank-eight court belt.
translations.idiomatic: The public-service belt followed the design of a civil rank-eight court belt.

sentences.zh: 吉服冠，頂銀座，上銜素金。

translations.literal: The auspicious-dress crown has a silver mount, set with plain gold on top.
translations.idiomatic: The auspicious-dress crown rose from a silver mount surmounted by plain gold.

sentences.zh: 貢生吉服冠，鏤花金頂。

translations.literal: A tribute student's auspicious-dress crown uses an openwork gold top.
translations.idiomatic: A tribute student's auspicious-dress crown used an openwork gold peak.

sentences.zh: 餘同舉人。

translations.literal: The rest is the same as a provincial graduate's.
translations.idiomatic: In all other respects it followed a provincial graduate's regalia.

sentences.zh: 監生吉服冠，素銀頂。

translations.literal: Imperial Academy student auspicious-dress cap, plain silver peak.
translations.idiomatic: An Imperial Academy student's auspicious-dress cap bore a plain silver peak.

sentences.zh: 餘同貢生。

translations.literal: The rest is the same as a tribute student.
translations.idiomatic: In all other respects his attire followed that of a tribute student.

sentences.zh: 生員冠，頂鏤花銀座，上銜銀雀。

translations.literal: Licentiate cap: openwork floral silver mount on top, set with a silver sparrow on top.
translations.idiomatic: The licentiate cap rose from an openwork floral silver mount and was surmounted by a silver sparrow.

sentences.zh: 公服袍，藍綢青緣。

translations.literal: Formal service robe, blue silk with blue-green edging.
translations.idiomatic: The formal service robe was blue silk with blue-green edging.

sentences.zh: 披領如袍式。

translations.literal: Draped collar in the style of the robe.
translations.idiomatic: The draped collar followed the style of the robe.

sentences.zh: 公服帶，制如文九品朝帶。

translations.literal: Formal service belt, regulation as the civil rank-nine court belt.
translations.idiomatic: The formal service belt followed the regulations for a civil rank-nine court belt.

sentences.zh: 吉服冠，頂與監生同。

translations.literal: Auspicious-dress cap, peak the same as an Imperial Academy student's.
translations.idiomatic: The auspicious-dress cap peak matched that of an Imperial Academy student.

sentences.zh: 外郎、耆老，冠頂以錫。

translations.literal: Outer clerk and village elder: cap peak of tin.
translations.idiomatic: Outer clerks and village elders wore tin cap peaks.

sentences.zh: 從耕農官，袍以青絨為之。

translations.literal: Attendant plowing officials, robe made of blue velvet.
translations.idiomatic: Attendant plowing officials wore robes of blue velvet.

sentences.zh: 頂同八品。

translations.literal: Peak the same as rank eight.
translations.idiomatic: The crown peak matched that of rank eight.

sentences.zh: 祭祀文舞生冬冠，騷鼠為之，頂鏤花銅座，中飾方銅，鏤葵花，上銜銅三角，如火珠形。

translations.literal: Sacrificial civil dance performer winter cap, made of sable, openwork floral copper mount on top, adorned with square copper in the middle, openwork sunflower, set with copper triangle on top, like a fire-pearl shape.
translations.idiomatic: The sacrificial civil dancer's winter cap was made of sable; its openwork floral copper mount bore square copper in the center worked with sunflowers and was surmounted by a copper three-point ornament shaped like a fire pearl.

sentences.zh: 袍以綢為之，其色南郊用石青，北郊用黑，各壇廟俱用紅，惟夕月壇用月白。

translations.literal: Robe made of silk; for color, the Southern Altar uses azurite blue, the Northern Altar uses black, all altars and temples use red, only the Evening Moon Altar uses moon white.
translations.idiomatic: The robe was silk; at the Southern Suburban Altar it was azurite blue, at the Northern Suburban Altar black, at all other altars and temples red, and only at the Evening Moon Altar moon white.

sentences.zh: 前後方襴銷金葵花。

translations.literal: Front and back square panels, cut-gold sunflowers.
translations.idiomatic: Square panels front and back bore cut-gold sunflowers.

sentences.zh: 帶用綠綢。

translations.literal: Belt uses green silk.
translations.idiomatic: The belt was green silk.

sentences.zh: 武舞生冠頂上銜銅三棱，如古戟形。

translations.literal: Military dance performer's cap peak set with copper three-sided ornament on top, like an ancient halberd shape.
translations.idiomatic: The military dancer's cap peak was surmounted by a copper three-edged ornament shaped like an ancient halberd.

sentences.zh: 袍以綢為之，通銷金葵花。

translations.literal: Robe made of silk, throughout cut-gold sunflowers.
translations.idiomatic: The robe was silk worked throughout with cut-gold sunflowers.

sentences.zh: 餘俱與文舞生同。

translations.literal: All the rest is the same as civil dance performers.
translations.idiomatic: In all other respects their attire matched the civil dancers'.

sentences.zh: 樂部樂生，冠頂鏤花銅座，上植明黃翎。

translations.literal: Music department musicians, cap peak openwork floral copper mount, bright yellow plumes planted on top.
translations.idiomatic: Music department musicians wore cap peaks with openwork floral copper mounts topped with bright yellow plumes.

sentences.zh: 樂部袍紅緞為之，一，前後方襴綉黃鸝，中和韶樂部樂生執戲竹人服之；

translations.literal: Music department robe made of red satin; one type—front and back square panels embroidered with yellow orioles—worn by Zhonghe Shaoyue department musicians holding bamboo drama figures;
translations.idiomatic: Music department robes were red satin; one version, with yellow orioles embroidered on square panels front and back, was worn by Zhonghe Shaoyue musicians carrying bamboo drama puppets;

sentences.zh: 一，通織小團葵花，丹陛大樂諸部樂生服之。

translations.literal: One type—throughout woven small round sunflowers—worn by Danbi Dayue various department musicians.
translations.idiomatic: the other, worked throughout with small round sunflowers, was worn by musicians of the various Danbi Dayue departments.

sentences.zh: 帶均用綠雲緞。

translations.literal: Belts all use green cloud satin.
translations.idiomatic: All belts were green cloud satin.

sentences.zh: 鹵簿輿士冬冠，以豹皮及黑氈為之，頂鏤花銅座，上植明黃翎，袍如丹陛大樂諸部樂生。

translations.literal: Processional palanquin bearers winter cap, made of leopard skin and black felt, openwork floral copper mount on top, bright yellow plumes planted on top, robe like Danbi Dayue various department musicians.
translations.idiomatic: Processional palanquin bearers' winter caps were leopard skin and black felt, with openwork floral copper mounts topped by bright yellow plumes; their robes matched those of Danbi Dayue musicians.

sentences.zh: 帶如祭祀文舞生。

translations.literal: Belt like sacrificial civil dance performers.
translations.idiomatic: The belt matched that of sacrificial civil dancers.

sentences.zh: 鹵薄護軍袍石青緞為之，通織金壽字，片金緣。

translations.literal: Processional guard robe made of azurite-blue satin, throughout woven gold longevity characters, gilt edging.
translations.idiomatic: Processional guards wore azurite-blue satin robes worked throughout with gold longevity characters and gilt edging.

sentences.zh: 領、袖俱織金葵花。

translations.literal: Collar and sleeves all embroidered with gold sunflowers.
translations.idiomatic: Collar and sleeves alike bore gold sunflower embroidery.

sentences.zh: 鹵簿校尉冬冠，平檐，頂素銅，上植明黃翎。

translations.literal: Processional sergeants winter cap, flat brim, plain copper peak, bright yellow plumes planted on top.
translations.idiomatic: Processional sergeants' winter caps had flat brims and plain copper peaks topped with bright yellow plumes.

sentences.zh: 袍、帶俱同鹵簿輿士。

translations.literal: Robe and belt both the same as processional palanquin bearers.
translations.idiomatic: Robe and belt both matched those of processional palanquin bearers.

sentences.zh: 順治三年，定庶民不得用緞綉等服。

translations.literal: Shunzhi third year, fixed that commoners may not use satin, embroidery, and such dress.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Shunzhi it was ordained that commoners were forbidden to wear satin, embroidered garments, and the like.

sentences.zh: 滿洲家下仆隸有用蟒緞、妝緞、錦繡服飾者，嚴禁之。

translations.literal: Manchu household servants and slaves who use python satin, ornamental satin, and brocade-embroidered dress and ornaments—strictly forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Manchu household servants and slaves found wearing python satin, ornamental satin, or brocade embroidery were strictly forbidden to do so.

sentences.zh: 九年，定涼帽、暖帽圓月，惟職官用紅片金，庶人則用紅緞。

translations.literal: Ninth year, fixed summer hat and winter hat round moon ornament, only officials use red gilt edging, commoners then use red satin.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year it was fixed that the round moon ornament on summer and winter hats might be red gilt edging for officials but red satin for commoners.

sentences.zh: 僧道服，袈裟、道服外，許用絹紡絲素紗各色，布袍用土黑、糹由黑二色。

translations.literal: Monk and Daoist dress, apart from kasaya and Daoist robes, permitted to use silk, spun silk, and plain gauze in various colors; cloth robes use earth-black and dark pongee black.
translations.idiomatic: Monks and Daoists, aside from kasaya and Daoist robes, were permitted various silks, spun silks, and plain gauzes; cloth robes were limited to earth black and dark pongee black.

sentences.zh: 康熙元年，定軍民人等有用蟒緞、妝緞、金花緞、片金倭緞、貂皮、狐皮、猞猁猻為服飾者，禁之。

translations.literal: Kangxi first year, fixed that military and civilian persons who use python satin, ornamental satin, golden-flower satin, gilt Japanese satin, sable fur, fox fur, and lynx for dress and ornaments—forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Kangxi it was forbidden for soldiers and civilians to wear python satin, ornamental satin, golden-flower satin, gilt Japanese satin, sable, fox, or lynx fur.

sentences.zh: 三十九年，定八旗舉人、官生、貢生、生員、監生、護軍、領催許服平常緞紗。

translations.literal: Thirty-ninth year, fixed that Eight Banners provincial graduates, official students, tribute students, licentiates, Imperial Academy students, guards, and levy officers permitted to wear ordinary satin and gauze.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-ninth year provincial graduates, official students, tribute students, licentiates, Imperial Academy students, guards, and levy officers of the Eight Banners were permitted to wear ordinary satin and gauze.

sentences.zh: 天馬、銀鼠不得服用。

translations.literal: Tianma fur and silver mouse fur may not be worn.
translations.idiomatic: Tianma fur and silver mouse fur were forbidden.

sentences.zh: 漢舉人、官生、貢生、監生、生員除狼皮外，例亦如之。

translations.literal: Han provincial graduates, official students, tribute students, Imperial Academy students, licentiates except wolf fur, regulations likewise as above.
translations.idiomatic: Han provincial graduates, official students, tribute students, Imperial Academy students, and licentiates were subject to the same regulations except that wolf fur was permitted.

sentences.zh: 軍民胥吏不得用狼狐等皮。

translations.literal: Military and civilian clerks and subofficials may not use wolf, fox, and such furs.
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers, civilians, and clerical subofficials were forbidden to wear wolf, fox, and similar furs.

sentences.zh: 有以貂皮為帽者，並禁之。

translations.literal: Those who use sable fur for caps—also forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Wearing sable fur caps was likewise forbidden.

sentences.zh: 又兵民人等鞍轡不得用綉緞、倭緞、搭線、鑲緣及鍍金為飾。

translations.literal: Moreover military and civilian persons' saddles and bridles may not use embroidered satin, Japanese satin, paired cord trim, inlaid edging, and gilt gold for ornament.
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers and civilians were also forbidden to ornament saddles and bridles with embroidered satin, Japanese satin, paired cordwork, inlaid edging, or gilding.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年，以職官不按定例，懸帶數珠，馬項下懸紅纓，使人前馬。

translations.literal: Yongzheng first year, because officials did not follow fixed regulations, wearing prayer beads on the belt, red tassels hung under the horse's neck, making men walk before horses.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yongzheng, because officials ignored prescribed regulations—wearing prayer beads on their belts, hanging red tassels from horses' necks, and making attendants walk ahead of their mounts—

sentences.zh: 又有越分者，坐褥至以綢為之。

translations.literal: There were also those who overstepped rank, seat cushions even made of silk.
translations.idiomatic: and some who overstepped their station even made seat cushions of silk—

sentences.zh: 令八旗大臣、統領衙門及都察院嚴行稽察，如大臣等徇情疏忽，同罪。

translations.literal: Ordered Eight Banners grand ministers, command headquarters offices, and the Censorate strictly to investigate; if grand ministers and the like show favoritism and neglect, same crime.
translations.idiomatic: an order went forth that Eight Banners grand ministers, command headquarters, and the Censorate should investigate strictly, with ministers who showed favoritism or negligence punished equally.

sentences.zh: 至諸王間賞所屬人員數珠等物，並行文本旗記檔，歲應匯奏。

translations.literal: As for various princes occasionally bestowing prayer beads and such items upon subordinates, memorial documents should be sent to note in the banner archives, annually should be submitted in aggregate report.
translations.idiomatic: When princes occasionally bestowed prayer beads and similar items on subordinates, written notices were to be filed in the banner archives and reported annually in aggregate.

sentences.zh: 二年，又申明加級官員頂帶、補服、坐褥越級僭用之禁。

translations.literal: Second year, again clarified the prohibition on promoted-rank officials' cap peaks, belts, badge surcoats, seat cushions over-rank usurpation of use.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year the prohibition on promoted officials' over-rank use of cap peaks, belts, badge surcoats, and seat cushions was reaffirmed.

sentences.zh: 官員軍民服色有用黑狐皮、秋香色、米色、香色及鞍轡用米色、秋香色者，於定例外，加罪議處。

translations.literal: Officials, military, civilians whose dress colors use black fox fur, autumn-scent color, rice color, fragrance color, and saddles and bridles using rice color, autumn-scent color—in addition to fixed regulations, additional guilt and deliberation for disposition.
translations.idiomatic: Officials, soldiers, and civilians found wearing black fox fur or the colors autumn-scent, rice, or fragrance—or using rice or autumn-scent colors on saddles and bridles—were to be punished beyond the fixed regulations.

sentences.zh: 該管官員不行舉發亦如之。

translations.literal: Responsible officials who do not report and expose—likewise.
translations.idiomatic: Responsible officials who failed to report such violations were likewise liable.
